## Why Choose Cleveland Clinic?

[patient centered care icon]

### Patient-centered care:

We don’t just care for your health conditions. We care about you. That means [our providers][65]
take the time to listen to what’s important to you before recommending next steps.

[national recognition icon]

### National recognition:

Cleveland Clinic is recognized in the U.S. and throughout the world for its expertise and care.

[skilled and collaborative providers icon]

### Collaborative providers:

You’ll get care from board-certified and fellowship trained experts who work together to create a
treatment plan just for you. Only the highest standards ensure [excellent outcomes][66].

[Innovation and Research Icon]

### Innovation and research:

We’re focused on today — and tomorrow. Our focus on [research][67] and offering the latest options
means you can find a wide range of [clinical trials][68] and other care that you can’t find
elsewhere.

## For Providers

Explore a curated collection of helpful resources and tools for medical professionals

### Institutes & Departments

Connect with expert teams across our [Institutes and Departments][91] to collaborate on patient care
and drive better outcomes.

### Join Our Nursing Team

Whether you’re just graduating from nursing school or have years of experience, you can build an
exceptional career in [nursing at Cleveland Clinic][92].

### Careers

As one of the nation’s — and the world’s — leading academic medical centers, you can grow in a
setting where you’ll make a difference. [Find your career][93] at Cleveland Clinic.

### Refer a Patient

We welcome the opportunity to partner with you in caring for your patients. Our dedicated [Referring
Physician team][94] is available from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. EST every day for you and your patients.

### ConsultQD

A [site for physicians and healthcare professionals][95] from Cleveland Clinic. Discover the latest
research insights, innovations and treatment trends.

### Education

We’re dedicated to training the next generation of healthcare professionals. Explore the [training
and education programs][96] we offer worldwide.

### Research

We’re committed to improving care and finding tomorrow’s cures. Learn about our [cutting-edge basic,
translational and clinical research][97].

### View All Resources for Providers

View our [full list of resources][98] for medical professionals, including our Alumni Association,
DrConnect, and MyPractice.

take the time to listen to what’s important to you before recommending next steps.

Cleveland Clinic is recognized in the U.S. and throughout the world for its expertise and care.

[skilled and collaborative providers icon]

You’ll get care from board-certified and fellowship trained experts who work together to create a
treatment plan just for you. Only the highest standards ensure [excellent outcomes][66].

We’re focused on today — and tomorrow. Our focus on [research][67] and offering the latest options
means you can find a wide range of [clinical trials][68] and other care that you can’t find
elsewhere.

### A Tradition of Excellence

Concentra leads the industry in outcomes-based occupational health services. Founded in 1979,
Concentra’s 12,000+ colleagues treat more than 50,000 patients a day on average from
625+ occupational health centers, 410+ onsite health clinics at employer locations, and Concentra
Telemed. We work with companies in a range of industries with employee populations of any size and
deliver quality services designed to optimize employee health and safety.

# CONCENTRA

## Because your employees matter.

### Partner With Us
* [Get started now][155]

### Concentra HUB 

Online authorizations, access to test results and reporting, and more.
A self-service tool and gateway to Concentra account information you need when you need it.
Explore features and benefits or log in now.
* [Want To Learn More?][156]
* [Log in now][157]

### Employer Resources
* [Step inside a Concentra medical center.][158]

Explore our occupational health care services.

Designed to meet the needs of employers and employees nationwide.

* [Get peer review from Medical ReviewStream][180]

### A Tradition of Excellence

Concentra leads the industry in outcomes-based occupational health services. Founded in 1979,
Concentra’s 12,000+ colleagues treat more than 50,000 patients a day on average from
625+ occupational health centers, 410+ onsite health clinics at employer locations, and Concentra
Telemed. We work with companies in a range of industries with employee populations of any size and
deliver quality services designed to optimize employee health and safety.

About Us

## Who is Medcor?

Medcor is your workforce health advocate. We provide unbiased occupational health programs that
guide employees to the right care at the right time while helping employers lower costs and reduce
risk.

Our services are trusted across North America because they:
* Reduce unnecessary claims and offsite visits
* Support OSHA and regulatory compliance
* Improve worker health, safety and productivity

[Learn More About Us][77]
Our Services

## Our Occupational Health Services

Medcor’s occupational health system of care supports every aspect of worker wellbeing and workplace
safety, helping employers reduce risk, improve outcomes and create healthier worksites.

# Go where you're more than a policy

[
Become a member
][66][
Learn how a membership
with Pinnacol pays off
arrow_forward
][67]
Suzanna is one of our Claims Representatives
[
[Pinnacol Edge logo]
Up to 15% savings for new members
arrow_forward_ios
][68]

## Members we protect

## You deserve a different kind of workers’ comp partner

Your workers’ comp insurance should work for you, not against you. With a Pinnacol membership, you
get access to Colorado’s No.1-rated workers’ comp that provides tailored and data-backed solutions,
lowers your insurance costs and sends money back to your bottom line.
* #### 45,000+
  
  Members
* #### 110 years
  
  of service
* #### $415M
  
  in member reinvestment over the last 10 years

## A membership that pays off

Explore how a Pinnacol membership delivers unmatched expertise that protects your business and
bottom line.

[[Murdoch’s and Pinnacol hitch up for claims success]

### Murdoch’s and Pinnacol hitch up for claims success

Murdoch cuts lost-time claims for bigger savings with support from Pinnacol.
Learn more
arrow_forward
][69]
[[From schools to pools: School district gets high marks in workers’ comp]

### From schools to pools: School district gets high marks in workers’ comp

Pinnacol brought a tailored approach to the Five Star District and its diverse set of hazards.
Learn more
arrow_forward
][70]
[[Staffing agency leads with empathy, sees policy costs drop]

### Staffing agency leads with empathy, sees policy costs drop

Pinnacol helps staffing agency achieve a 72% reduction in claims.
Learn more
arrow_forward
][71]
[[Trucker and nonprofit get injured workers back in the saddle]

### Trucker and nonprofit get injured workers back in the saddle

Trucking company saves on claims costs while supporting nonprofits with help from Pinnacol.
Learn more
arrow_forward
][72]
[
View all
arrow_forward
][73]

### What our members are saying

We build long-term relationships and provide comprehensive support that goes beyond the standard
workers' comp policy.

[
Become a member
][74]

## Your membership benefits

With a Pinnacol membership, you get a suite of comprehensive services at no additional cost. These
services drive down workplace injuries, close claims faster, and return workers to the job sooner to
reduce insurance costs.

[Illustration of a customer holding a bag of purchases at the counter where a black female is behind
the register.]

#### Pinnacol Edge™

We provide up to 15% in savings up front through our customer-exclusive services that lower
insurance costs over time.

#### Nationwide coverage

Pinnacol goes wherever your business grows. Our flexible coverage options safeguard your business as
it expands.
[Illustration of a moving company and workers moving a bicycle off a truck and into a house.]

#### Return to Work

Get your injured workers back on the job quickly and safely with our Return to Work program.
Pinnacol has an injured worker satisfaction score of 4.2 out of 5.
[Illustration of a construction crew with cranes and bulldozers and a forman holding up an
architectural drawing]

#### Proactive safety services

We partner with you to create customized solutions for a safer workplace. Members achieve a 20%
decrease in claim frequency even three years after a safety visit.
[Illustration of 3 medical professionals.]

#### Expert claims handling

Our team makes the claims process fast and simple. We resolve claims 31% faster than the industry
average.
[Illustration of chefs in a kitchen with speech bubbles above their heads.]

#### Spanish-language support

We provide support, training and resources entirely in Spanish to empower our Spanish-preferred
customers.

## Explore the latest

[

### Pinnacol’s claims expertise delivers for members

According to the latest NCCI data, Pinnacol handles claims faster, more accurately, and more
cost-effectively than any other carrier in Colorado.

Learn more
arrow_forward
][75]
[

### Pinnacol invests in a coffee apprenticeship program brewing brighter futures

With support from Pinnacol, a nonprofit is using craft coffee to create career pathways for young
adults.

Learn more
arrow_forward
][76]
[

### Pinnacol's Registered Apprenticeship: Building Colorado's Future Workforce from Within

Hear how David Lopez began a career at 16, and how Pinnacol's apprenticeship program led him to a
Journeyworker credential and an underwriting career that supports his family.

Learn more
arrow_forward
][77]
[

### 3 ways to foster a back-to-work culture

Having a back to work program in place benefits your employees and your business.

Learn more
arrow_forward
][78]

## Putting care to work^{®}

It’s more than a slogan — it’s how we show up for our injured workers every day.

Hear their stories:

[

### Trusting the process after a workplace injury

Hear her story of how Pinnacol went above and beyond after a workplace injury, providing exceptional
medical care and support throughout her recovery.

Learn more
arrow_forward
][79]
[

### From Pipes to Pain, and Back Again

In this testimonial, Jimmy and Judy share their touching story about how Pinnacol supported their
family during a difficult time.

Learn more
arrow_forward
][80]
[

### Peace of Mind After a Workplace Injury: Kenny's Story

When this Colorado native took a fall off a ladder at work, the unknown left him scared and unsure
of how he’d make ends meet.

Learn more
arrow_forward
][81]
[

### Colorado worker receives much-needed care

After a back injury at work, this Colorado cabinet maker received compassionate support from
Pinnacol.

Learn more
arrow_forward
][82]

## Putting care to work

We believe in giving back to our community. In 2024 alone, we donated over $1.1 million and logged
over 3,000 employee volunteer hours. Through our grants and sponsorships, we invest in workforce
development, employee wellness and safety programs that build long-term resilience statewide.

[
Learn more
][83]

## Ready to become a Pinnacol member?

A Pinnacol membership is open to all employers with a Colorado connection. Don’t settle for just a
policy. We’re here to deliver value for the long haul.

## Your membership benefits

With a Pinnacol membership, you get a suite of comprehensive services at no additional cost. These
services drive down workplace injuries, close claims faster, and return workers to the job sooner to
reduce insurance costs.

[Illustration of a customer holding a bag of purchases at the counter where a black female is behind
the register.]

#### Pinnacol Edge™

We provide up to 15% in savings up front through our customer-exclusive services that lower
insurance costs over time.

#### Nationwide coverage

Pinnacol goes wherever your business grows. Our flexible coverage options safeguard your business as
it expands.
[Illustration of a moving company and workers moving a bicycle off a truck and into a house.]

#### Return to Work

Get your injured workers back on the job quickly and safely with our Return to Work program.
Pinnacol has an injured worker satisfaction score of 4.2 out of 5.
[Illustration of a construction crew with cranes and bulldozers and a forman holding up an
architectural drawing]

#### Proactive safety services

We partner with you to create customized solutions for a safer workplace. Members achieve a 20%
decrease in claim frequency even three years after a safety visit.
[Illustration of 3 medical professionals.]

#### Expert claims handling

Our team makes the claims process fast and simple. We resolve claims 31% faster than the industry
average.
[Illustration of chefs in a kitchen with speech bubbles above their heads.]

#### Spanish-language support

We provide support, training and resources entirely in Spanish to empower our Spanish-preferred
customers.

[Safety National - A Partner Like No Other]

# A Partner Like No Other

Relationships are fundamental to our process at Safety National^{®}. We develop true partnerships
with our clients fostered by active listening and a deep commitment to finding solutions. We
communicate early and often, keeping every promise we make along the way.

[Learn more about our company.][78]

[Safety National - Persistent Versatility]

# Persistent Versatility

Brokers love to work with Safety National^{®} because of our flexible and customizable approach. We
offer personalized treatment to each client and, as a flat organization, we can promptly make
decisions and respond quickly to questions or concerns.

[Learn more about our insurance and reinsurance solutions.][79]

[Safety National - Add Value at Every Opportunity]

# Add Value at Every Opportunity

Safety National^{®} serves as a steadfast ally to our clients. We provide a suite of risk management
services to help prevent employee injuries and deliver unique catastrophic claims expertise to help
achieve the best possible outcomes when the worst happens.

[Learn more about our risk services.][80]

[Learn more about our claims services.][81]

[Safety National - Industry Expertise That Is Second to None]

# Industry Expertise That Is Second to None

As an industry leader, Safety National^{®} stands firm in the belief that it is the company’s
responsibility to share its specialized expertise. We value our reputation as a trusted source on
industry trends and emerging needs.

[View our thought leadership resources.][82]

[Safety National - Our Remarkable Story]

# Our Remarkable Story

See how Safety National^{®} – a small company born out of excess workers’ compensation market
instability concerns during World War II – evolved into one of the leading providers of insurance
and reinsurance solutions within the United States.

[View our timeline of company milestones.][83]

[Safety National - A Partner Like No Other]

# A Partner Like No Other

Relationships are fundamental to our process at Safety National^{®}. We develop true partnerships
with our clients fostered by active listening and a deep commitment to finding solutions. We
communicate early and often, keeping every promise we make along the way.

[Learn more about our company.][78]

[Safety National - Persistent Versatility]

# Persistent Versatility

Brokers love to work with Safety National^{®} because of our flexible and customizable approach. We
offer personalized treatment to each client and, as a flat organization, we can promptly make
decisions and respond quickly to questions or concerns.

[Learn more about our insurance and reinsurance solutions.][79]

[Safety National - Add Value at Every Opportunity]

# Add Value at Every Opportunity

Safety National^{®} serves as a steadfast ally to our clients. We provide a suite of risk management
services to help prevent employee injuries and deliver unique catastrophic claims expertise to help
achieve the best possible outcomes when the worst happens.

[Learn more about our risk services.][80]

[Learn more about our claims services.][81]

[Safety National - Industry Expertise That Is Second to None]

# Industry Expertise That Is Second to None

As an industry leader, Safety National^{®} stands firm in the belief that it is the company’s
responsibility to share its specialized expertise. We value our reputation as a trusted source on
industry trends and emerging needs.

[View our thought leadership resources.][82]

[Safety National - Our Remarkable Story]

# Our Remarkable Story

See how Safety National^{®} – a small company born out of excess workers’ compensation market
instability concerns during World War II – evolved into one of the leading providers of insurance
and reinsurance solutions within the United States.

[View our timeline of company milestones.][83]

We work closely with international, federal, state, and local governments to build safe, secure,
healthy, and thriving communities. Our comprehensive business practices solve a wide range of
challenges, including Occupational Health Services, Emergency & Disaster Response & Recovery,
Medical Services, Civil Services, Program & Construction Management, Environmental Remediation,
Security Services, and Base Operations & Facilities Management.

Whether it's responding to global health crises, securing international missions, ensuring workforce
safety, or leveraging advanced technologies for large-scale project management, Acuity International
is your trusted partner.

### **Pediatric Urgent Care**

Our urgent care centers are staffed with clinicians experienced in treating pediatric conditions
when you need medical care immediately. We work with you so you know exactly what the diagnostic
steps are to a healthy recovery.

[ Read More ][71]
[A woman with gray hair and a face mask sits in a medical office, holding her phone, and speaks with
a healthcare professional also wearing a face mask at the urgent care clinic.]

### **Urgent Care**

Get immediate care for emergencies that don’t necessarily require a trip to the ER. From accidents
and injuries to colds and flus, our team of specialists provide expert care for life’s small
emergencies. With on-site lab and x-ray equipment, we can handle more severe urgent care services,
such as broken bones and burns, that a walk-in center cannot.

[ Read More ][72]
[A doctor in a white coat checks the pulse of a patient while seated at a desk with a clipboard at
an urgent care clinic.]

### **Primary Care**

Our primary care services deliver prompt medical care at a substantially lower cost. If you are
looking for a primary care clinician but the high cost of  medical care is a barrier, call your
nearest AFC center to get the care you need.

[ Read More ][73]
[A healthcare professional at an urgent care facility examines a baby with a stethoscope while the
baby is held by an adult.]

### **Family Care**

Our experienced and compassionate team provides full-service family care with the ease of a walk-in
clinic.  We offer routine physicals, and treatment for illness and injury.  Our express lab speeds
diagnostic and screening services when time is of the essence.

[ Read More ][74]
[A gloved hand places a blood sample vial with a purple cap into a machine containing similar vials
at the medical center.]

### **On site Labs**

Our express lab services offer diagnostics and speedy test results without having to go to another
medical facility. If your primary care provider requires you to go to the nearby hospital or clinic
for your tests, choose the one-stop shop of our AFC medical centers.

[ Read More ][75]
[An elderly man in a white shirt holds a tissue to his nose, appearing to sneeze or blow his nose.
Seated in a room with a television in the background, he might be contemplating whether to visit an
urgent care center.]

### **Seasonal Allergy Treatment**

Seasonal allergy symptoms can flare up in the spring when there’s a lot of pollen in the air.  If
seasonal allergies make you miserable year after year, call AFC and our professional medical team
will help identify your allergy and reduce your discomfort.

[ Read More ][76]
[X-ray image of a human chest, taken at an urgent care facility, showing the ribcage, spine,
clavicles, and part of the shoulder joints.]

### **X-rays**

Our urgent care centers offer x-rays as a part of their service offerings. X-rays are required for
common urgent care diagnostics. Why go to the hospital when AFC can help with common urgent care
conditions like pneumonia and fractures?

[ Read More ][77]

## How can we **help?**

### Immigration Physicals


### Men's Physical Exam

### Women's Physical Exam

### Routine Checkups

[A man and a young girl consult with a doctor via a laptop for urgent care. The girl holds a
thermometer as the man looks on.]

### **Immigration Physicals**

Do you need an immigration exam? Many of our locations offer immigration physicals to help you
provide the health care documentation you need.  We offer a warm and caring environment for all of
our patients.  Call us today to schedule your appointment.

[ Read More ][78]
[annual physical exam discussion with the doctor]

### **Men's Physicals**

During your physical exam, we typically begin with your medical history, diet, exercise, any
allergies to medications and any history of smoking, and alcohol consumption. Vital signs are
checked and a thorough physical exam is performed. Men have specific needs when it comes to health
and aging.  Take advantage of the convenience AFC offers and get a yearly exam today.

[ Read More ][79]
[A person in a doctor's coat holding a small pink female symbol between their hands, with a
stethoscope around their neck, stands in front of the medical center.]

### **Women's Physicals**

We are focused on caring for women at every stage of life. Our providers work to establish trusting,
lasting relationships with our patients, from their teen years to the decades after menopause. 
Women’s physicals offer peace of mind. From routine care to health concerns, our staff is ready to
help.

[ Read More ][80]
[A doctor uses a stethoscope to examine a patient's chest in the medical center.]

### **Wellness Physicals**

A wellness exam is a preventive physical examination that can potentially spot problems sooner. You
don’t need a primary care doctor or hospital network, which can make scheduling and affording these
exams more challenging. Our walk-in services mean you don’t have to wait to get the care you need.

[ Read More ][81]
[A young woman with curly hair wearing a denim shirt smiles while speaking to another person holding
a clipboard at the medical center.]

### **Routine Checkups**

Routine checkups and annual physicals are likely the most important medical appointments you’ll need
during the year.  Chronic diseases, illnesses, and major healthcare problems can be easily prevented
by staying on top of your medical needs. Routine physicals review your medical history to help
identify healthcare risks and overall health

[ Read More ][82]
[A doctor wearing a white coat, stethoscope, and face mask stands with arms crossed in an urgent
care facility.]

### **Physicians On-site**

Sometimes you need medical attention right away, but it’s not an emergency. For illnesses and
injuries that require a physician, many of our locations maintain board-certified doctors.  Our
quick, convenient on-site laboratory makes diagnosis and response time much faster.

[ Read More ][83]
[A scientist wearing a face mask and gloves uses a pipette in a medical laboratory, focusing on a
specimen in a petri dish.]

### **STD Testing**

We offer STD tests with no appointment necessary, and our convenient hours make it easy for you to
come in. If you are looking for an urgent care center nearest you for an STD test, feel free to book
your confidential appointment online and take control of your sexual health.

[ Read More ][84]

clinic setting.]

### **Vaccines- Immunizations**

Immunizations and vaccinations can help protect you against contagious diseases. We offer common
immunizations, including tetanus shot, flu shot, and Tdap to keep you and those around you healthy.

[ Read More ][85]
[A person receives a vaccine injection in the upper arm from a healthcare worker wearing blue gloves
at an urgent care center.]

### **Vaccines - Travel Medicine**

Get vaccinated before you travel. It’s important to make your appointments and get your
immunizations about a month before your trip.  At AFC we offer walk-in vaccinations to get you on
the road faster.

[ Read More ][86]
[A healthcare professional at an urgent care facility administers a vaccine to a woman wearing a
pink mask and a floral shirt. Both are masked for safety.]

### **Vaccines - Wellness**

Don’t be at risk for preventable diseases which result in poor health.  Keep your vaccinations
up-to-date with AFC and protect your loved ones from highly-preventable illnesses.

### **Pediatric Urgent Care**

Our urgent care centers are staffed with clinicians experienced in treating pediatric conditions
when you need medical care immediately. We work with you so you know exactly what the diagnostic
steps are to a healthy recovery.

[ Read More ][71]
[A woman with gray hair and a face mask sits in a medical office, holding her phone, and speaks with

### **Urgent Care**

Get immediate care for emergencies that don’t necessarily require a trip to the ER. From accidents
and injuries to colds and flus, our team of specialists provide expert care for life’s small
emergencies. With on-site lab and x-ray equipment, we can handle more severe urgent care services,
such as broken bones and burns, that a walk-in center cannot.

[ Read More ][72]
[A doctor in a white coat checks the pulse of a patient while seated at a desk with a clipboard at
an urgent care clinic.]

### **Primary Care**

Our primary care services deliver prompt medical care at a substantially lower cost. If you are
looking for a primary care clinician but the high cost of  medical care is a barrier, call your
nearest AFC center to get the care you need.

[ Read More ][73]
[A healthcare professional at an urgent care facility examines a baby with a stethoscope while the
baby is held by an adult.]

### **Family Care**

Our experienced and compassionate team provides full-service family care with the ease of a walk-in
clinic.  We offer routine physicals, and treatment for illness and injury.  Our express lab speeds
diagnostic and screening services when time is of the essence.

[ Read More ][74]
[A gloved hand places a blood sample vial with a purple cap into a machine containing similar vials
at the medical center.]

### **On site Labs**

Our express lab services offer diagnostics and speedy test results without having to go to another
medical facility. If your primary care provider requires you to go to the nearby hospital or clinic
for your tests, choose the one-stop shop of our AFC medical centers.

[ Read More ][75]
[An elderly man in a white shirt holds a tissue to his nose, appearing to sneeze or blow his nose.
Seated in a room with a television in the background, he might be contemplating whether to visit an
urgent care center.]

### **Seasonal Allergy Treatment**

Seasonal allergy symptoms can flare up in the spring when there’s a lot of pollen in the air.  If
seasonal allergies make you miserable year after year, call AFC and our professional medical team
will help identify your allergy and reduce your discomfort.

[ Read More ][76]
[X-ray image of a human chest, taken at an urgent care facility, showing the ribcage, spine,
clavicles, and part of the shoulder joints.]

### **X-rays**

Our urgent care centers offer x-rays as a part of their service offerings. X-rays are required for
common urgent care diagnostics. Why go to the hospital when AFC can help with common urgent care
conditions like pneumonia and fractures?

[ Read More ][77]

### **Immigration Physicals**

Do you need an immigration exam? Many of our locations offer immigration physicals to help you
provide the health care documentation you need.  We offer a warm and caring environment for all of
our patients.  Call us today to schedule your appointment.

[ Read More ][78]
[annual physical exam discussion with the doctor]

### **Men's Physicals**

During your physical exam, we typically begin with your medical history, diet, exercise, any
allergies to medications and any history of smoking, and alcohol consumption. Vital signs are
checked and a thorough physical exam is performed. Men have specific needs when it comes to health
and aging.  Take advantage of the convenience AFC offers and get a yearly exam today.

[ Read More ][79]
[A person in a doctor's coat holding a small pink female symbol between their hands, with a
stethoscope around their neck, stands in front of the medical center.]

### **Women's Physicals**

We are focused on caring for women at every stage of life. Our providers work to establish trusting,
lasting relationships with our patients, from their teen years to the decades after menopause. 
Women’s physicals offer peace of mind. From routine care to health concerns, our staff is ready to
help.

[ Read More ][80]
[A doctor uses a stethoscope to examine a patient's chest in the medical center.]

### **Wellness Physicals**

A wellness exam is a preventive physical examination that can potentially spot problems sooner. You
don’t need a primary care doctor or hospital network, which can make scheduling and affording these
exams more challenging. Our walk-in services mean you don’t have to wait to get the care you need.

[ Read More ][81]
[A young woman with curly hair wearing a denim shirt smiles while speaking to another person holding
a clipboard at the medical center.]

### **Routine Checkups**

Routine checkups and annual physicals are likely the most important medical appointments you’ll need
during the year.  Chronic diseases, illnesses, and major healthcare problems can be easily prevented
by staying on top of your medical needs. Routine physicals review your medical history to help
identify healthcare risks and overall health

[ Read More ][82]
[A doctor wearing a white coat, stethoscope, and face mask stands with arms crossed in an urgent
care facility.]

### **Physicians On-site**

Sometimes you need medical attention right away, but it’s not an emergency. For illnesses and
injuries that require a physician, many of our locations maintain board-certified doctors.  Our
quick, convenient on-site laboratory makes diagnosis and response time much faster.

[ Read More ][83]
[A scientist wearing a face mask and gloves uses a pipette in a medical laboratory, focusing on a
specimen in a petri dish.]

### **STD Testing**

We offer STD tests with no appointment necessary, and our convenient hours make it easy for you to
come in. If you are looking for an urgent care center nearest you for an STD test, feel free to book
your confidential appointment online and take control of your sexual health.

[ Read More ][84]

### **Vaccines- Immunizations**

Immunizations and vaccinations can help protect you against contagious diseases. We offer common
immunizations, including tetanus shot, flu shot, and Tdap to keep you and those around you healthy.

[ Read More ][85]
[A person receives a vaccine injection in the upper arm from a healthcare worker wearing blue gloves
at an urgent care center.]

### **Vaccines - Travel Medicine**

Get vaccinated before you travel. It’s important to make your appointments and get your
immunizations about a month before your trip.  At AFC we offer walk-in vaccinations to get you on
the road faster.

[ Read More ][86]
[A healthcare professional at an urgent care facility administers a vaccine to a woman wearing a
pink mask and a floral shirt. Both are masked for safety.]

### **Vaccines - Wellness**

Don’t be at risk for preventable diseases which result in poor health.  Keep your vaccinations
up-to-date with AFC and protect your loved ones from highly-preventable illnesses.

## Common Questions About Employee Wellness Programs.

We already have a wellness solution. Why switch?+
Most wellness programs offer one thing: a step tracker, an EAP, or a gym discount. Avidon is a
single platform covering all major behavioral drivers of chronic disease, from coaching and courses
to challenges and health risk identification. It replaces the patchwork, not just one piece. Plus,
with our completion rates, your employees will actually use it.
How do we know employees will actually use it?+
Engagement is our strongest metric. 91% of participants complete our courses. 88% achieve their
health goals. 91% say Avidon was essential to their success. We achieve this through proven
behavioral science (CBT-based course design), gamification (challenges and leaderboards), and
personalized health coaching that meets people where they are.
We don't have the budget for a wellness program.+
Unhealthy employees cost far more than a wellness program. Absenteeism, presenteeism, and higher
insurance premiums add up quickly. Avidon costs a fraction of hiring a wellness coordinator or
running in-house programs. We offer flexible plans including month-to-month options and pilot
programs. [See our pricing page for details][111].
We don't have the HR resources to manage another program.+
That's exactly who we built this for. Avidon is turnkey and self-managed. Courses launch
automatically, challenges run monthly with no admin work, and reporting dashboards update in
real-time. No IT support required for setup. You configure it once and it runs.
Is the platform HIPAA-compliant?+
Yes. Avidon is fully HIPAA-compliant with secure messaging, encrypted data storage, and
enterprise-grade security protocols. We sign BAAs with all clients and follow strict data handling
procedures.
How long does implementation take?+
Most clients launch within minutes, not months. We handle the setup, including branding, SSO
configuration, and member onboarding. Your team gets immediate access to courses, challenges, and
coaching tools.
Can we customize it for our organization?+
Yes. Our no-code platform lets you personalize content, challenges, branding, and communication
without IT support. You can white-label the experience, configure SSO, set up custom wellness hubs,
and automate outreach. APIs and webhooks are available for deeper integrations.
What if our employees are remote or on different shifts?+
Avidon is fully digital and accessible on any device, anytime. Content, courses, and challenges work
asynchronously. There's no scheduling requirement. Remote, hybrid, and shift workers all participate
on their own time.
How is Avidon different from other wellness platforms?+
Three things set us apart. First, real behavioral science: everything is grounded in CBT, not just
content libraries. Second, a truly turnkey experience: no wellness coordinator needed. Third,
measurable outcomes: 91% course completion, 88% goal achievement, and 91% say Avidon was essential
to their success.

## Gamification for healthier and more engaged employees

[Achieve more with gamification."]

The Changers Fit App tackles a key challenge in behavioral economics: simply knowing something
doesn’t change how we act. But when knowledge translates into tangible rewards, it motivates people
to embrace healthier habits, become more mindful, and take action for the climate.

“Compared to other health activities, Changers has been very well received: one third of the
employees have signed up – and without extensive advertising. ... Changers is contemporary, the app
combines many elements – nutrition, meditation, prevention, running, safety at work, cycling. An
all-round successful offer for our employees.”
[Steffen P.]
Steffen P.Employee & Social Affairs Officer Lidl
“The “bonus principle” of Changers is exactly the way we consider successful to create awareness for
CO2 savings among the population: I am doing something for myself and thus for climate protection at
the same time. Initially, setting this up for individual companies activates the employees. The
premiums provided by the company are offset against Gold Standard CO2 certificates from ADVANTAG.”
[Raik H.]
Raik H.Managing Director ADVANTAG Services GmbH
“The main focus for us is the opportunity for our colleagues to do something good for the
environment and promote health at the same time. The app motivates because our employees can plant
trees by choosing environmentally conscious means of transport. We raise awareness of Changers via
our intranet and are happy to see increasing numbers of participants. The feedback from staff is
very positive, we really like the app.”
[Silke D.]
Silke D.Corporate Responsibility Manager EY
“The app never gets boring for our employees - there’s always something new happening.”
Rifka P.Expert Health, Work & Family, ING

## Gamification for healthier and more engaged employees

[Achieve more with gamification."]

The Changers Fit App tackles a key challenge in behavioral economics: simply knowing something
doesn’t change how we act. But when knowledge translates into tangible rewards, it motivates people
to embrace healthier habits, become more mindful, and take action for the climate.

“Compared to other health activities, Changers has been very well received: one third of the
employees have signed up – and without extensive advertising. ... Changers is contemporary, the app
combines many elements – nutrition, meditation, prevention, running, safety at work, cycling. An
all-round successful offer for our employees.”
[Steffen P.]
Steffen P.Employee & Social Affairs Officer Lidl
“The “bonus principle” of Changers is exactly the way we consider successful to create awareness for
CO2 savings among the population: I am doing something for myself and thus for climate protection at
the same time. Initially, setting this up for individual companies activates the employees. The
premiums provided by the company are offset against Gold Standard CO2 certificates from ADVANTAG.”
[Raik H.]
Raik H.Managing Director ADVANTAG Services GmbH
“The main focus for us is the opportunity for our colleagues to do something good for the
environment and promote health at the same time. The app motivates because our employees can plant
trees by choosing environmentally conscious means of transport. We raise awareness of Changers via
our intranet and are happy to see increasing numbers of participants. The feedback from staff is
very positive, we really like the app.”
[Silke D.]
Silke D.Corporate Responsibility Manager EY
“The app never gets boring for our employees - there’s always something new happening.”
Rifka P.Expert Health, Work & Family, ING

### WHAT IS CHAWA

CHAWA is a multidisciplinary platform that unites the full spectrum of health, wellness, and
workplace support services into a structured and collaborative network.
‍

As the first association of its scale dedicated to corporate health and wellness, CHAWA integrates
clinical care, preventive health, lifestyle optimisation, and organisational wellbeing into a
cohesive and practical approach.
‍

With its foundation in Malaysia and a growing international presence, CHAWA brings together leading
professionals, providers, and organisations to collectively raise the standard of workplace health
through collaboration, innovation, and shared expertise.
‍

Through structured initiatives, continuous dialogue, and knowledge development, CHAWA enables
organisations and professionals to contribute to and benefit from a forward-thinking global movement
in workplace wellbeing.
[show][19]

Our Network

## Our Network of Health and Wellness Providers

CHAWA brings together a comprehensive range of providers across medical, allied health, wellness,
training, and corporate support services, ensuring organisations have access to high-quality,
multidisciplinary solutions.
‍

All providers and members undergo a structured evaluation process prior to onboarding, with strong
emphasis on expertise, credibility, and service excellence. This ensures that the CHAWA network
represents a high standard of capability and professionalism.
‍

The network continues to expand with the onboarding of qualified experts and organisations,
supported by ongoing collaboration, dialogue, and knowledge exchange to strengthen collective
impact.

workplace support services into a structured and collaborative network.

clinical care, preventive health, lifestyle optimisation, and organisational wellbeing into a

**The benefits of corporate health**

Scientific research has shown the financial benefits to companies of comprehensive wellness
programmes. We can design bespoke programmes to increase and maintain the fitness of employees over
their working lifetime. These can take the form of regular medical examinations for the workforce at
which general health issues such as weight, blood pressure stress and regular exercise are
discussed, or specially designed events which meet the specific needs of a company and its
workforce.

Any business is likely to encounter a variety of problems related to health. These health issues can
reduce productivity and increase loss of revenue. These may be individual problems like returning an
employee to work following illness or injury, checking employees health before hiring or broader
issues related to general working conditions, stress in the workplace , noise exposures and many
others.

A healthy workforce is a happy and more productive one and our corporate occupational health
services are designed to help you address any health issues in a cost effective manner. 

**Contact us today for a free no obligation quote**

We will be happy to discuss your company's needs and devise a programme especially for you and your
employees, so contact our experienced team today for an informal discussion on how we can help you.

## Strategic Support for Senior Leaders

Supporting senior leaders and organizations with confidential counsel, board-level strategic
advisory, and organizational resilience assessments — grounded in real executive experience.

01

### Executive Confidential Counsel

A private, judgment-free sounding board for senior leaders facing the complex challenges and
isolation of leadership.

[ Explore → ][20]
02

### Board-Level Strategic Advisory

Strategic guidance for boards seeking to integrate wellbeing into governance and build resilient
leadership environments.

[ Explore → ][21]
03

### Organizational Resilience Assessments

Comprehensive, business-focused evaluation of organizational resilience with practical strategies
for sustainable solutions.

[ Explore → ][22]
04

### Speaking & Keynote Engagements

TEDx organizer, IoD speaker, and Stevie Awards judge. Available for keynote addresses, panel
discussions, and executive workshops.

[ Explore → ][23]
Testimonials

★ ★ ★ ★ ★

C

Chris Saxby

Executive Leader

A

NED / Consultant, CDir FIoD

## Doctors on Duty Offers Urgent Care, Primary Care & Occupational Medicine Services on the Central
## Coast

Our mission is to provide fast, affordable medical services to the communities we serve in Monterey
and Santa Cruz counties. We’ve been helping people with urgent medical problems since 1988 and
understand the healthcare needs of residents on the Central Coast. Our highly skilled staff and
providers offer essential health care services at a lower cost than an emergency room and with a
shorter wait time.

[Read More][21]

We’re the medical clinic you and your family can turn to when you simply can’t wait to be seen at a
traditional doctor’s office. We provide care for non life-threatening conditions – whether it’s a
cold or flu, a broken bone or allergic reaction, or even a minor burn or sprain – when are where you
need it in one of our 9 clinics. We also provide traditional primary care services, including school
and sports physicals, wellness exams, flu shots, x-rays, immunizations and rapid lab tests.
We understand that life is unpredictable. At our walk-in clinics, we see patients with or without an
appointment and many of our clinics are even there for you on nights, weekends, and holidays. We
accept most major forms of insurance, including Medicare and CCAH. We also welcome self-pay patients
with or patients with high deductible plans. Our fees vary by the treatment given but our prices are
a fraction of the cost of an emergency room visit.
Whenever you need us, we’ll be there. Simply find the location nearest you in Salinas, Monterey, or
Santa Cruz, and come in for fast and affordable care. You can hold a place in line or set up a
virtual visit by visiting our website.

[Services the Central Coast]

### [URGENT & PRIMARY CARE][22]

Can’t wait for an appointment to see a doctor? At Doctors on Duty you don’t need an appointment.
Just walk into one of our 9 convenient locations or grab a spot in line on our website.

### [OCCUPATIONAL MEDICINE][23]

We can help with keeping your employees healthy and productive with our Industrial Medicine
services. We perform pre-employment exams, drug screens, hearing tests and other health surveillance
services. We can also care for injured workers and manage their return to full duty.

### [SPECIALTY SERVICES][24]

Doctors on Duty Medical Clinics offer a comprehensive set of services for our patients including
Pain Management, Behavioral Health and Gynecology. Direct access to these specialties within our
clinics offers convenient, timely referrals to the care you need.

## Doctors on Duty Offers Urgent Care, Primary Care & Occupational Medicine Services on the Central
## Coast

Our mission is to provide fast, affordable medical services to the communities we serve in Monterey
and Santa Cruz counties. We’ve been helping people with urgent medical problems since 1988 and
understand the healthcare needs of residents on the Central Coast. Our highly skilled staff and
providers offer essential health care services at a lower cost than an emergency room and with a
shorter wait time.

[Read More][21]

We’re the medical clinic you and your family can turn to when you simply can’t wait to be seen at a
traditional doctor’s office. We provide care for non life-threatening conditions – whether it’s a
cold or flu, a broken bone or allergic reaction, or even a minor burn or sprain – when are where you
need it in one of our 9 clinics. We also provide traditional primary care services, including school
and sports physicals, wellness exams, flu shots, x-rays, immunizations and rapid lab tests.
We understand that life is unpredictable. At our walk-in clinics, we see patients with or without an
appointment and many of our clinics are even there for you on nights, weekends, and holidays. We
accept most major forms of insurance, including Medicare and CCAH. We also welcome self-pay patients
with or patients with high deductible plans. Our fees vary by the treatment given but our prices are
a fraction of the cost of an emergency room visit.
Whenever you need us, we’ll be there. Simply find the location nearest you in Salinas, Monterey, or
Santa Cruz, and come in for fast and affordable care. You can hold a place in line or set up a
virtual visit by visiting our website.

[Services the Central Coast]

### [URGENT & PRIMARY CARE][22]

Can’t wait for an appointment to see a doctor? At Doctors on Duty you don’t need an appointment.
Just walk into one of our 9 convenient locations or grab a spot in line on our website.

### [OCCUPATIONAL MEDICINE][23]

We can help with keeping your employees healthy and productive with our Industrial Medicine
services. We perform pre-employment exams, drug screens, hearing tests and other health surveillance
services. We can also care for injured workers and manage their return to full duty.

### [SPECIALTY SERVICES][24]

Doctors on Duty Medical Clinics offer a comprehensive set of services for our patients including

# Your Audiometric Equipment Sales and Support Experts

We provide more than innovative hearing and balance equipment — we deliver unmatched solutions,
enhanced by professional service. Our local presence means less downtime for your clinic. Our
mission is to empower you to provide the best patient experience, through the right solution, backed
by exceptional support.

[About Us][21]

## Need Support?

We provide expert calibration, repair, and preventative maintenance to ensure your diagnostics
equipment remains accurate, reliable, and compliant. Our skilled technicians offer on-site and
remote services, minimizing downtime and keeping your equipment in top condition.

screening, vision screening, pulmonary function, breath alcohol and more.

across each of your locations.

[Get Support][30]

## e3 Occupational Health Supports Your Entire Program

### Equipment Provider

e3 Diagnostics has been the leading provider of audiology equipment in the United States for 30
years.

### Training & Certifications

Training your team and testers has never been easier with local instructors available nationwide.

### Records Management

As a top provider for hearing health, we have created specialized programs for managing and storing
testing data.

Inevitably, you equipment will need a calibration to maintain OSHA standards and our local techs are
standing by.

## About e3 Diagnostics

e3 Diagnostics is a nationwide team of experts with years of experience in occupational health
equipment sales and service. With over 30 offices strategically located across the United States, we
bring a local expertise that is unmatched by any others in the field of occupational health
instrumentation.

Our team consists of technicians who are certified by their respective manufacturers to provide you
with high-end technical support for all your equipment needs. We also have a pool of engineers on
staff who can help design custom solutions for your unique requirements.

Our goal is to ensure that our customers have access to the best products available at competitive
prices, while providing them with exceptional support services.

Check out e3 health solutions today.

Occupational Health training is one of the most important aspects of occupational health and safety
management, as it ensures that workers receive the information they need to be safe at work.

teach participants how to create a culture of safety within their organization, following
governmental guidelines, as well as how to select and manage employees in order to ensure that
hazards are identified and mitigated before they become an issue.

[TEKLİF AL][28]

## OSGB Hizmetleri

İş sağlığı ve güvenliği (İSG) kanunu tüm çalışanları kapsamaktadır. Efor OSGB; Çalışma ve Sosyal
Güvenlik Bakanlığı (ÇSGB) İSGGM tarafından yetkilendirilmiş, İstanbul Ortak Sağlık Güvenlik
Birimi’dir. Tecrübeli işyeri hekimi ve iş güvenliği uzmanlarımızla; işyerinizde çalışanlarınız daha
sağlıklı, güvenli ve verimli olacaklar. [OSGB Hizmeti >>][29]

## Sertifikalı Eğitimler

İş sağlığı güvenliği mevzuatı gereği tüm çalışanların temel İSG eğitimi alması zorunludur. Ayrıca
sertifikalı olarak; Acil Durumlar, Yangınla Mücadele, Deprem, Yüksekte Güvenli Çalışma ve
ilkyardımcı Eğitimleri organize etmekteyiz. Eğitimlerimizle işletmeniz ve çalışanlarınız risk ve
tehlikelere karşı çok daha bilinçli ve hazırlıklı olacaktır. [İSG Eğitimi >>][30]

## Diğer Hizmetler

Efor OSGB İstanbul olarak, Şirketlerin tüm İSG ihtiyaçlarına stratejik çözüm ortağı olmayı
amaçlamaktayız. İSG risk değerlendirmesi raporu, Acil durum eğitim tatbikatları, sağlık raporu,
işyeri ortam ölçümleri, periyodik test ve kontroller, ISO 45001 İSG YS kurulması ve bağımsız İSG
denetimi gibi, katma değerli hizmetler sunmaktayız. [Mobil Sağlık >>][31]

İş kazalarını ve meslek hastalıklarını önleyerek; işyerlerinin daha sağlıklı ve güvenli olması için

and gives leaders the visibility they need to make faster, better decisions. The result: fewer
incidents, lower costs, and a workforce that goes home safe.

# Where Complex Risks Meet Their Match.

Sophisticated, hands-on expertise – keeping clients protected, prepared and thriving.

[Talk With an EPIC Specialist][183] [Explore Our Services][184]

## Specialized Risk Expertise, Delivered at Scale

EPIC is a national specialty insurance brokerage and risk advisory firm — and one of the largest
independent brokers in the U.S.

### An A-Team for Every Client

Every engagement starts with the right specialists: advisors with a deep understanding of your
industry and the personal and operational realities that shape your risk.

### Laser-Focused on Your Strategy 

We show up as strategic partners – and stay close, stay curious and stay invested in your future.

### National Scale, Local Depth

We combine strong analytics and market relationships with sharp insights across industries,
disciplines and exposures: clients get the depth of a boutique specialist and the breadth of a
national firm – at the same table.

## A Different Kind of National Broker.

Businesses across industries rely on EPIC to solve operational challenges, manage risk, and move
forward with confidence.

Do feel free to contact us to discuss your requirements and see how easy it is to arrange a flexible
quality Occupational Health Assessment.

## Regulations & Guidelines

All Everwell Occupational Health services, health surveillance and medicals are, naturally,
compliant with the latest HSE, COSHH and other statutory regulations and guidelines. Everwell
operates across all the main industrial sectors from extraction/mining through manufacturing &
processing to distribution. We also look after the workplace occupational health requirements for
many other diverse clients including those companies & organisations involved in office based
activities, automotive sector, bodyshops, educational establishments, IT, UK charities,
construction, food preparation & more.

## Flexibility across the UK

Everwell is a very flexible independent Occupational Health Provider, offering bespoke and tailored
services for your organisation. Everwell’s Northwest head office is based in Cheshire just south of
Manchester.  We have a number of direct clinics across the UK and also run an extensive nationwide
network of Occupational Health Nurse Advisors and Physicians that can deliver a full range of Health
Surveillance, Sickness Absence Management and Medicals in any part of the UK.

We have a very responsive service that can arrange [Occupational Health Assessments][61] across the
UK on a single one-off basis or as part of a larger contract.  We can match our delivery to your
requirements and we currently complete  over 100 consultations per week throughout the UK through a
combination of Occupational Health Physician or Nurse Advisor telephone and face-to-face
appointments.

## A Professional No-Nonsense Service

Our strategy is to keep everything simple (deliver what you need when you need it), maintain a low
cost base, employ the best professional Occupational Health Specialists to work closely with HR &
Line Management and, above all, deliver a first class value for money service.

Whether you require a full-time comprehensive workplace based OH Service, a single sickness absence
referral or a company wide Occupational Health Assessment service contact us today for more
information on how we could help you and become your Occupational Health Provider of choice.

# Start Your Career In Nursing

Jumpstart your nursing career with EveryNurse. Discover expert career and education resources for
every stage of your nursing journey.
[ Nursing Careers ][63]
[ Nursing Programs ][64]

## Explore Nursing Schools & Program Rankings

EveryNurse provides extensively researched, independent program rankings to help students find the
best schools for their chosen specialty.
[Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources]

### CNA Classes

Your gateway to becoming a Certified Nursing Assistant. Learn essential skills to provide basic
patient care and support in healthcare settings.
[CNA Classes][65]
[Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources][Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources]

### CNA to RN Programs

Bridge the gap from CNA to Registered Nurse with specialized programs. Elevate your career through
advanced training.
[CNA to RN Programs][66]
[Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources][Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources]

### LPN Programs

Discover accredited LPN programs near you and kickstart your nursing career in 12 to 15 months.
[LPN Programs][67]
[Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources][Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources]

### ADN Degree

An Associate Degree in Nursing is a popular and efficient route to becoming a registered nurse. It
offers a quicker and more affordable path than a traditional four-year degree.
[ADN Degree][68]
[Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources][Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources]

### BSN Degree

A BSN degree is a higher education program that typically takes four years to complete and offers a
comprehensive education in nursing theory, clinical practice, and healthcare management.
[BSN Degree][69]
[Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources][Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources]

### RN to BSN Programs

RN to BSN programs empower registered nurses to advance their education, obtaining a BSN degree for
enhanced career opportunities and skill development.
[RN to BSN Programs][70]
[Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources][Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources]

### MSN Degree

An MSN degree is a graduate-level nursing program that equips nurses with advanced skills,
specialized knowledge, and leadership abilities to excel in various healthcare roles
[MSN Degree][71]
[Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources][Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources]

### DNP Programs

DNP programs offer the highest level of nursing education, preparing nurses for leadership, advanced
practice, and evidence-based patient care.
[DNP Programs][72]

## Hear From Other Nurses

Each nurse’s journey is unique. We aim to highlight their firsthand experiences, providing an
insider’s perspective on the nursing profession.

One of the most rewarding aspects of my 20-year nursing career is the diverse opportunities
available. I’ve worked in various settings, including labor and delivery, ambulatory care, the
Intensive Care Unit, home health, informatics, leadership roles, and clinical practice. I love
helping people at all stages of life and am very proud or my nursing profession.

[Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources]

### Marlyn C.

#### MSN, RN

One of the most fulfilling aspects of nursing is the profound connections we build with our
patients. Despite often encountering them during challenging times – supporting them through health
crises, witnessing births, or providing end-of-life care – we quickly establish deep bonds and play
a pivotal role in their lives.

[Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources][Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources]

### Susan A.

#### DNP, RN, CNL

One of the most rewarding aspects of nursing is the ability to explore various roles and specialties
while remaining in the same profession. Throughout my 15-year nursing career, I’ve transitioned
between roles in med-surg, critical care, case management, and ER and received training in several
other areas. Nursing offers endless opportunities for change and growth – if you’re feeling burnt
out or something new is a better fit for your life, your skills can easily be applied to a new area
within nursing.

Jumpstart your nursing career with EveryNurse. Discover expert career and education resources for
every stage of your nursing journey.
[ Nursing Careers ][63]
[ Nursing Programs ][64]

## Explore Nursing Schools & Program Rankings

EveryNurse provides extensively researched, independent program rankings to help students find the
best schools for their chosen specialty.
[Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources]

### CNA Classes

Your gateway to becoming a Certified Nursing Assistant. Learn essential skills to provide basic
patient care and support in healthcare settings.
[CNA Classes][65]
[Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources][Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources]

### CNA to RN Programs

Bridge the gap from CNA to Registered Nurse with specialized programs. Elevate your career through
advanced training.
[CNA to RN Programs][66]
[Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources][Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources]

### LPN Programs

Discover accredited LPN programs near you and kickstart your nursing career in 12 to 15 months.
[LPN Programs][67]
[Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources][Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources]

### ADN Degree

An Associate Degree in Nursing is a popular and efficient route to becoming a registered nurse. It
offers a quicker and more affordable path than a traditional four-year degree.
[ADN Degree][68]
[Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources][Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources]

### BSN Degree

A BSN degree is a higher education program that typically takes four years to complete and offers a
comprehensive education in nursing theory, clinical practice, and healthcare management.
[BSN Degree][69]
[Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources][Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources]

### RN to BSN Programs

RN to BSN programs empower registered nurses to advance their education, obtaining a BSN degree for
enhanced career opportunities and skill development.
[RN to BSN Programs][70]
[Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources][Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources]

### MSN Degree

An MSN degree is a graduate-level nursing program that equips nurses with advanced skills,
specialized knowledge, and leadership abilities to excel in various healthcare roles
[MSN Degree][71]
[Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources][Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources]

### DNP Programs

DNP programs offer the highest level of nursing education, preparing nurses for leadership, advanced
practice, and evidence-based patient care.
[DNP Programs][72]

Embark on a journey of discovery through the world of nursing careers. Explore the diverse
opportunities available, from traditional roles in hospitals to positions beyond the bedside.

## Hear From Other Nurses

Each nurse’s journey is unique. We aim to highlight their firsthand experiences, providing an
insider’s perspective on the nursing profession.

One of the most rewarding aspects of my 20-year nursing career is the diverse opportunities
available. I’ve worked in various settings, including labor and delivery, ambulatory care, the
Intensive Care Unit, home health, informatics, leadership roles, and clinical practice. I love
helping people at all stages of life and am very proud or my nursing profession.

[Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources]

### Marlyn C.

#### MSN, RN

One of the most fulfilling aspects of nursing is the profound connections we build with our
patients. Despite often encountering them during challenging times – supporting them through health
crises, witnessing births, or providing end-of-life care – we quickly establish deep bonds and play
a pivotal role in their lives.

[Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources][Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources]

### Susan A.

#### DNP, RN, CNL

One of the most rewarding aspects of nursing is the ability to explore various roles and specialties
while remaining in the same profession. Throughout my 15-year nursing career, I’ve transitioned
between roles in med-surg, critical care, case management, and ER and received training in several
other areas. Nursing offers endless opportunities for change and growth – if you’re feeling burnt
out or something new is a better fit for your life, your skills can easily be applied to a new area
within nursing.

[Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources]

#### BSN, RN

### KUDUWAVE PORTABLE AUDIOMETER USED BY NASA ASTRONAUTS

 “NASA recently deployed a modified Kuduwave audiometer to the International Space Station (ISS).
Space-X’s Crew-2 astronauts used this Kuduwave to successfully complete an inaugural series of
audiometry and tympanometry tests aboard the ISS.

The Kuduwave’s unique noise attenuation and noise monitoring features are well suited for the
challenge of assessing hearing in ambient noise levels created by the ISS’s multiple fans and
hardware systems.

The astronauts’ collected data are now being analyzed at the Johnson Space Center Audiology Clinic
in Houston, Texas and all future hearing assessments on the ISS will employ this Kuduwave
audiometer.”

**Dr Richard Danielson**

*Manager for Audiology & Hearing Conservation, Human Health & Performance, NASA-Johnson Space
Center, Houston, Texas, USA*

#### HOW MED TECH HELPS YOUR BUSINESS **Stop Buying Equipment. Start Investing in Freedom**

Let’s be blunt. Investing in “technology” is a tired conversation. Your practice doesn’t need more
wires, more beige boxes, or more things that need a dedicated room. That’s not growth; it’s just
clutter.

The real question is, how does your tech amplify your purpose? The right tools don’t just create
efficiency; they spark moments of genuine human connection. They don’t just offer portability; they
grant you the freedom to practice audiology on your own terms.

This is your playbook for choosing **Inventive HealthTech** that does more than just tick a box.
This is about elevating your practice, your patients, and the human spirit. If your current tools
aren’t liberating you from the booth and delivering **Dignified Diagnostics** with **Daring
Simplicity**, then they aren’t just holding you back, they’re costing you the future of audiology.

Browse plans that can help you get coverage for medical costs not covered by your medical plan.

## Frequently asked questions about health insurance

### What is health insurance?

Health insurance is a plan, or policy, that covers a percentage of doctors’ visits and hospital
bills. It helps offset the costs of both planned and unplanned medical needs. Medical care can be
expensive, but health insurance may help lessen the financial burden.

And health insurance isn’t just for when you’re sick or injured. It can also help you stay healthy
through preventive care and wellness programs. This may help you save money, too, by catching
potential health concerns before they become larger issues.

### How does health insurance work?

Health insurance is a contract between you and an insurance company (the insurer). When you purchase
a plan, you become a member of that plan. Each month, you’ll likely pay a fee, called a premium, to
use the plan.

There are many different types of health plans, but they generally work the same way. You pay for
some medical costs and your insurer pays for some costs. How those costs break out depend on your
specific plan benefits and coverage.

[Learn more about how health insurance works][17]

### How do I get health insurance?

Finding the right health insurance plan depends on a variety of factors. These include things like
your age, health and financial situation. For example, if you’re over 65 or have a qualifying
disability or special situation, you may be eligible for [Medicare][18]. If you have a lower income,
you may qualify for [Medicaid][19]. If you want to purchase an individual plan, an [Affordable Care
Act (ACA)][20] plan could be an option. Or, you may have the option to get [health insurance through
your employer][21].

Most health insurance plans have a special period of time, usually once a year, when you can enroll.
This is called open enrollment. It’s when you can start, stop or change your health plan. Timing of
open enrollment varies based on the plan.

[Learn more about open enrollment][22]

### What are the different types of health insurance?

There are a variety of health insurance plans that fit different needs. Some plans are offered
through the government, like [Affordable Care Act (ACA)][23] plans, [Medicare][24] plans and
[Medicaid][25] plans. There are also health plans you can get through your employer. Or, you can
purchase a plan on your own, like [short term health insurance][26] that offers coverage for a
limited amount of time. Understanding the different health insurance options can help you find the
plan that may work best for you.

You may also see terms like HMO, PPO, EPO and POS ­— these refer to the four basic kinds of provider
networks that certain health plans may offer. A network may include doctors, hospitals and other
providers that agree to provide services to plan members at a negotiated rate. This may help lower
your out-of-pocket costs.

[Learn more about the different types of health insurance][27]

### How much does health insurance cost?

It depends. A variety of factors impact how much you pay. These can include your age, your location
and lifestyle habits. It also depends on the type of plan you choose. With some plans, you may pay
less up front, but more when you receive care. For other plans, the opposite can be true.

# Health insurance plans

## Health plans for life's moments

Our plans are made to deliver what matters, from quality coverage to caring support. Find a plan or
sign in to view your benefits.

[Member sign in][2]
[Shop for a plan][3]

[ Employers ][7]

## Already a member?

[Sign in to your account][8] to view your plan benefits.

### Try the UnitedHealthcare app

Members can get instant access to manage health plan details, request member ID cards, find care and
more.

[Learn more about the app for members][9]
[Open the app][10]

### Discover wellness and rewards programs

Invest in your health and find motivation and support. Plus, you may earn rewards for meeting health
goals.

[Explore wellness and rewards programs][11]

[Advertising policy][12]

## All types of plans for all types of people

### [Health insurance plans][13]

Explore a range of individual and family plan options, including ACA Marketplace plans.

### [Medicare plans][14]

Find coverage that goes beyond Original Medicare, including Medicare Advantage plans.

### [Medicaid plans][15]

See Medicaid plan options if you have low income or qualify due to a special circumstance.

### [Dental, vision and supplemental plans][16]

Browse plans that can help you get coverage for medical costs not covered by your medical plan.

## Frequently asked questions about health insurance

### What is health insurance?

Health insurance is a plan, or policy, that covers a percentage of doctors’ visits and hospital
bills. It helps offset the costs of both planned and unplanned medical needs. Medical care can be
expensive, but health insurance may help lessen the financial burden.

And health insurance isn’t just for when you’re sick or injured. It can also help you stay healthy
through preventive care and wellness programs. This may help you save money, too, by catching
potential health concerns before they become larger issues.

### How does health insurance work?

Health insurance is a contract between you and an insurance company (the insurer). When you purchase
a plan, you become a member of that plan. Each month, you’ll likely pay a fee, called a premium, to
use the plan.

There are many different types of health plans, but they generally work the same way. You pay for
some medical costs and your insurer pays for some costs. How those costs break out depend on your
specific plan benefits and coverage.

[Learn more about how health insurance works][17]

### How do I get health insurance?

Finding the right health insurance plan depends on a variety of factors. These include things like
your age, health and financial situation. For example, if you’re over 65 or have a qualifying
disability or special situation, you may be eligible for [Medicare][18]. If you have a lower income,
you may qualify for [Medicaid][19]. If you want to purchase an individual plan, an [Affordable Care
Act (ACA)][20] plan could be an option. Or, you may have the option to get [health insurance through
your employer][21].

Most health insurance plans have a special period of time, usually once a year, when you can enroll.
This is called open enrollment. It’s when you can start, stop or change your health plan. Timing of
open enrollment varies based on the plan.

[Learn more about open enrollment][22]

### What are the different types of health insurance?

There are a variety of health insurance plans that fit different needs. Some plans are offered
through the government, like [Affordable Care Act (ACA)][23] plans, [Medicare][24] plans and
[Medicaid][25] plans. There are also health plans you can get through your employer. Or, you can
purchase a plan on your own, like [short term health insurance][26] that offers coverage for a
limited amount of time. Understanding the different health insurance options can help you find the
plan that may work best for you.

You may also see terms like HMO, PPO, EPO and POS ­— these refer to the four basic kinds of provider
networks that certain health plans may offer. A network may include doctors, hospitals and other
providers that agree to provide services to plan members at a negotiated rate. This may help lower
your out-of-pocket costs.

[Learn more about the different types of health insurance][27]

### How much does health insurance cost?

It depends. A variety of factors impact how much you pay. These can include your age, your location
and lifestyle habits. It also depends on the type of plan you choose. With some plans, you may pay
less up front, but more when you receive care. For other plans, the opposite can be true.

[Learn more about health insurance costs][28]

### What does health insurance cover?

Coverage is unique to each health plan. Many plans may cover things like preventive care,
prescription drugs, hospital stays, mental health services and more. A plan may cover the full cost
of certain services, or you may have to share costs (by paying a copay or coinsurance, for example)
until you meet a deductible or out-of-pocket limit.

Make sure to review benefits and coverage before choosing a plan. You can find this information in
the plan’s Summary of Benefits and Coverage. This is a document that all health plan companies are
required to provide. It outlines what’s covered, partially covered or not covered under a health
plan.

[Learn how to review a Summary of Benefits and Coverage][29]
[Learn more about health insurance][30]
[Get the facts about how the health system works][31]

## Working to make the health care experience better

UnitedHealthcare puts care at the heart of health insurance. Empathy, transparency and human
connection guide us. Because better care comes from understanding what people need — and making
quality care more personal.

[About us][84]
[Join us][85]

## The UK’s leading provider of workplace health services

We are proud to be a centre of clinical excellence in occupational health, helping organisations of
all sizes take care of their people and create high-performing teams.

[Group of employees]
[Employees]
[Group of employees infront of MMU ]

## Helping people be their best

We believe that businesses work better when their people are at their best. We help organisations
work proactively to ensure a healthy and thriving workplace. Our occupational health experts offer
tailored solutions that put your people at the heart, covering health screenings, wellbeing and
neurodiversity coaching, onsite primary care, mental health support and more.

[See our services][86]
[Sunday Times 100 logo 2022 and 2023]

## Growing our company to better serve you

Proud to have been named as one of the 100 Fastest-growing Private Companies in the UK for two years
running!

# The UK's leading Workplace Health and Wellbeing event

****9-10th March 2027 | NEC Birmingham

 

### **

# Welcome

### 150+

### Exhibitors

Meet the UK's leading workplace health and wellbeing brands.

### 140+

### Sessions

With the most influential minds in the industry 

### 4000+

### Professionals

Working and in charge of workplace health and wellbeing

## Welcome to Health & Wellbeing at Work

We're a dynamic two-day event taking place on the **9th - 10th of March 2027 at the NEC,
Birmingham**, dedicated to cultivating authentic change within workplace health, wellbeing, and
culture through an unparalleled conference programme and our curated selection of cutting-edge
solutions and service providers. Our goal is to empower every employer with the inspiration,
insights and contacts to drive their workplace wellbeing strategy forward.

Join the movement, as together, we redefine workforce health & wellbeing. 

[Register Your Interest for 2027 now][84]

[ [Exhibit with us in 2027] ][85]

### Exhibit with us in 2027

We provide a platform for you to reach 4,000+ quality buyers with decision-making power. Exhibiting
at Health & Wellbeing at Work provides a unique opportunity for you to showcase your brand to an
audience seeking solutions and services in HR, wellbeing, and occupational health, grow your
business and brand exposure, and generate new leads and contacts.

Don’t miss out, join us in March 2027!

**[Enquire about a stand][86]**

[Visit Health and Wellbeing at Work 2026]

### Visit us in 2027

Be inspired by over 150 speakers discussing key themes and issues within the workplace health and
wellbeing industry. Visit and connect with 150 exhibitors demonstrating best practice and innovation
with their products and services.
 

**[Register your interest][87]**

 

[View the full conference programme][88]

Welcome to Health Matters

# A Flexible, Professional & Customer-Focused Occupational Health Service

Helping support your business safeguard its most valuable resource!

## Service Categories

[ [Pre-Placement & Pre-Employment Assessments] ][29]

### [Pre-Placement Health Assessment][30]

A key management tool that forms part of the recruitment process. This service aims to ensure that
newly placed employees’ health is sufficient to enable them to safely fulfill the duties of their
post, whilst also considering the safety of others.

[ More about service ][31]

### [Health Surveillance][32]

A system of ongoing health checks. These health checks, which are required by law, aim to detect
potential work-related ill-health at an early stage, enabling an employer to evaluate health risks
and implement and maintain adequate and appropriate control measures.
[ More about service ][33]
[ [Health Surveillance] ][34]
[ [Management Referrals] ][35]

### [Management Referrals][36]

A high quality and customer focused service enabling an employer to refer an employee for
independent health advice. The service aims to find solutions where an employee’s health may be
affecting their fitness to carry out their role, or their role may be adversely affecting their
health in some way.
[ More about service ][37]

### [Health & Wellbeing][38]

Unique and bespoke Health & Wellbeing services which provide employers with a range of effective
‘off the shelf’ tools to help improve health and well-being in the workplace and beyond.
