# Empowering good work through healthier people

We are a trusted partner for occupational health and wellbeing services, supporting organisations
throughout the employee lifecycle with flexible, high-quality solutions. We are driven by innovation
and integrity, to deliver meaningful and actionable outcomes that create healthier people and safer
workplaces.

[View our services][13]
[Empowering good work through healthier people]
[Empowering good work through healthier people]
Nationwide
We deliver consistent, reliable workplace health and wellbeing services across the UK and Ireland,
to reach every organisation.
Quality
We provide high-quality, evidence-based occupational health services to achieve better outcomes for
you and your people.
Long-term Partnerships
With a 99% customer retention rate, we build long-term partnerships that support employee health,
wellbeing and your business goals.

## Our services

We provide a comprehensive range of occupational health and wellbeing services that support
organisations throughout the employee lifecycle including pre-placement health screening and
onboarding support, occupational health assessments, vaccinations, absence management, ill-health
retirement applications, statutory health surveillance, treatment, and wellbeing services.

help employers create healthier workplaces while giving employees the support they need to succeed
at work.

[Watch video][30]
[Healthy people drive stronger business outcomes - Jackie Salvidge, CEO]

We view wellbeing through a biopsychosocial model, a clinically led approach to occupational health
assessments and workplace health management, enabling us to assess the wider factors affecting
health. By understanding the biological, psychological and social influences that impact an
individual, we can make more practical recommendations to drive positive change for people and
organisations. This enables you to overcome barriers around employees returning to work, remaining
in work and supporting them to perform at their best.

individual need, including Occupational Health Physicians, Occupational Health Advisors (OHAs),
Mental Health Clinicians, and Physiotherapists. This approach is proven to reduce the length and
frequency of short-term absence, reduce the progression of cases becoming long term, and support

# Put your employees' occupational health and wellbeing in safe hands

[100 Companies to inspire Britain 2019]
[100 Companies to inspire Britain 2018]
[100 Companies to inspire Britain 2017]
* Employee Screening
* Alcohol & Drugs Screening
* Employee Wellbeing
* Bespoke Solutions & Cutting Edge Technology
* UK Nationwide Coverage

Medigold Health creates occupational health and wellbeing solutions for employers across the UK. We
offer all manner of things that a caring employer might need to keep their people in work safe and
well, including absence management, employee occupational health assessments, help with alcohol and
drug issues, a vast array of employee health and wellbeing support and a range of other specialist
services.

We work with employers of all sizes, across all sectors – whether you’re a major blue-chip company
seeking to develop a bespoke corporate health and wellbeing programme, or a small business with
fewer than 250 employees looking to improve the medical and wellbeing support available to your
workforce, we can provide a tailored solution to suit you.

Our team of highly qualified and experienced occupational health professionals ensures that we are a
leading occupational health provider.

# Protecting Your Workforce. Reducing Downtime. Saving Lives.

Mission Zero Medical delivers professional on-site occupational healthcare, emergency medical
response, and technical rescue services that keep your employees safe and your projects moving.

Built by Critical Moments. Ready for Yours.

[Request a Free Quote][8][Schedule a Consultation][9]
24/7Emergency Response
100%Licensed Providers
On-SiteNot Clinic-Based
OSHACompliant Documentation

What We Do

## Comprehensive On-Site Medical Services

From first aid to emergency response — we bring the full spectrum of occupational healthcare
directly to your jobsite.

Core Service

### On-Site Medical Clinics

Fully staffed medical clinics deployed directly at your jobsite. Immediate care without the lost
time of off-site clinic visits.

Learn More
Emergency

### Emergency Medical Services

Licensed EMTs, Advanced EMTs, and Paramedics on standby — ready to respond the moment an incident
occurs.

Learn More
Specialized

### Technical Rescue

Confined space rescue, high-angle rope rescue, and industrial rescue teams for the most demanding
environments.

Learn More
Compliance

### OSHA Injury Management

Expert documentation, case management, and return-to-work coordination that keeps your OSHA
recordable rates low.

Learn More
Medical

### Occupational Medicine

Physician-led occupational health services including injury treatment, wellness checks, and medical
surveillance.

Learn More
Prevention

### Heat Illness Prevention

Proactive heat stress monitoring, hydration programs, and rapid response protocols for outdoor and
high-heat environments.

Learn More
Recovery

### Return-to-Work Evaluations

Structured evaluations that get injured workers back on the job safely — minimizing downtime and
workers' comp exposure.

Learn More
Standby

### Safety Standby

Dedicated medical personnel on standby during high-risk operations, shutdowns, turnarounds, and
special projects.

Learn More
Events

### Event Medical Coverage

Professional medical coverage for large-scale events, corporate gatherings, and public assemblies.

Learn More
[View All Services][10]

Where We Work

## Industries We Serve

From oil fields to wind farms — we go where the work is.

Commercial Construction
Industrial Construction
Manufacturing
Oil & Gas
Renewable Energy
Wind Farms
Solar Projects
Utilities
Agriculture
Mining
Warehousing
Data Centers
[Explore All Industries][11]

Our Difference

## Why Mission Zero Medical

We don't operate from a clinic down the road. We're embedded in your operation — ready before the
incident, not after.

### Physician-Led Care

Our medical programs are designed and overseen by licensed physicians with deep occupational
medicine expertise.

### On-Site, Not Off-Site

We deploy directly to your jobsite — eliminating the lost time, liability, and uncertainty of
sending workers to outside clinics.

### OSHA Expertise

Our providers are trained in OSHA recordability standards, ensuring accurate documentation that
protects your safety record.

### Rapid Deployment

We mobilize quickly — whether you need a single medic on standby or a full on-site clinic for a
500-person project.

## What do our clients say?

[preloader-image]

Having a workplace occupational health programme is vital to any organisation, I have worked with
the MOHS at a number of organisations over the years, as I moved to a new organisation, I did not
hesitate in contacting MOHS to set up a new occupational health programme. The quality of their
workplace assessment reports and recommendations are extremely high. In addition, the employees
involved have commented on the extremely helpful knowledge and support provided by the workplace
assessor.

### John Thompson, Alutrade

MOHS have always been extremely professional. The administration of appointments is always very
efficient and the follow up reports are concise, helpful and timely.  The professional relationship
between the Council and MOHS is first rate and MOHS employees are helpful and knowledgeable. During
our time working with MOHS, we have built up good working relationships with the OH Physicians and
the advice, guidance and support they provide is greatly appreciated. I would recommend MOHS to any
organisation that requires a first rate, professional Occupational Health provider.

The Group have used Midland Occupational Health Services (MOHS) for 10 years and have found them to
be very professional, informative and approachable. The Service provided is always of a high
standard and completed in a timely manner. A comprehensive report is provided at the end of each
site visit and where applicable constructive recommendations for any improvements required by the
Group are discussed. MOHS are always confidential and uphold the confidentiality of the individual
employees with whom they deal with.

### IMRSER

The Institute for Magnetic Resonance Safety, Education, and Research (IMRSER) was formed in response
to the growing need for information and research regarding MRI safety. IMRSER promotes awareness,
understanding, and communication of MR safety issues through education and research. Visit:
[**IMRSER.org**][10]

What to Expect During Your MRI, Projectile/Missile Effect videos, and Superconducting magnet
quenching shown from both inside and outside the MR system room. Visit: [**IMRSER Videos**][11]

### How does NPH Group make Occupational Health feel less like a second job for HR?

We reduce the day-to-day admin that usually sits with HR and H&S: chasing questionnaires, booking
appointments, tracking compliance, and following up reports. Our connected solutions (Role Ready,
Clear Path, and Health Track) streamline the workflow so you get clear outcomes, predictable
turnaround, and far less back-and-forth.

### What is Role Ready and how does it help HR and Health & Safety teams?  

Role Ready maps your job roles to the Occupational Health requirements that sit behind them. Instead
of reinventing the wheel for every new starter, site, or contract, you get a consistent, role-based
approach to what’s required, when it’s required, and why, helping you stay compliant without the
spreadsheet chaos.

### What is Clear Path and why does it improve the employee experience?

Clear Path replaces clunky electronic questionnaires with a simple, bespoke digital questionnaire
journey accessed via a company-specific magic link. It reduces drop-off, avoids incomplete forms,
and cuts the time HR spends chasing employees, while giving clinicians better information upfront
for faster, more accurate outcomes.

### What is Health Track and how does it reduce chasing and delays?

Health Track streamlines scheduling, recall, and workflow management so Occupational Health delivery
runs end-to-end with fewer manual steps. It helps keep appointments, follow-ups, and outcomes
moving, so you’re not stuck chasing updates, rebooking missed slots, or trying to piece together
what’s happening across multiple services.

### We’ve had inconsistent Occupational Health advice before, how is NPH Group different?

Consistency comes from strong clinical governance, clear processes, and a delivery model designed to
scale without losing quality. NPH Group focuses on practical, decision-ready outcomes for HR and
managers, so you get clear recommendations you can actually implement, not vague reports that create
more questions than answers.

# **Occupational Health and Wellbeing Solutions.**

## Your Partner in Health. Clinician-Led. Not-for-Profit. Here for You.

[ Request Support ][86]

Welcome to OH One: The UK's Not-for-Profit Occupational Health Provider for Business, HR & Employee
Wellbeing

At OH One, we deliver outstanding occupational health and wellbeing services to businesses across
the UK. As a SEQOHS-accredited provider, we set the standard for safety, quality, and effectiveness
in occupational health. Our personalised approach ensures every solution is tailored to meet the
specific needs of your organisation, helping you create a healthier, happier, and more productive
workforce.

Whether you need ad-hoc support, one-off interventions, or long-term strategies, OH One offers the
flexibility to provide the right services at the right time. By combining quality care with value,
we help businesses of all sizes achieve their health and wellbeing goals while enhancing employee
satisfaction and productivity.

Why OH One?

At OH One, we combine clinical expertise with a personal touch. Our timely and responsive approach
ensures your health concerns are addressed swiftly, helping your employees recover faster and return
to work with renewed energy.

Our reputation for excellence is reflected in our SEQOHS accreditation, and our services are
endorsed by Dr David C Batman, a leading Occupational Health Expert and Consultant Occupational
Health Physician.

We work with UK businesses across a range of industries, from SMEs to large organisations,
delivering practical and cost-effective solutions that drive results.

To learn more about what makes OH One the trusted choice for occupational health, visit our [Why
Choose Us ][87]page.

[Get in touch][88] with us today for a free consultation to discover how we can build a healthier,
happier future for your business.

Our Bespoke Health and Wellbeing Solutions
* [Health Surveillance UK]
  
  ## HSE-Compliant Health Surveillance
  
  Health surveillance is a legal requirement for employers whose staff are exposed to health risks
  such as noise, vibration, or hazardous substances. Our service supports you in meeting your HSE
  obligations with tailored programmes that include HAVS assessments, audiometry, skin checks, and
  more. Our process is efficient, confidential, and aligned with the latest UK workplace health
  standards.
  
  [Find out more][8

# **Occupational Health and Wellbeing Solutions.**

## Your Partner in Health. Clinician-Led. Not-for-Profit. Here for You.

[ Request Support ][86]

Welcome to OH One: The UK's Not-for-Profit Occupational Health Provider for Business, HR & Employee
Wellbeing

At OH One, we deliver outstanding occupational health and wellbeing services to businesses across
the UK. As a SEQOHS-accredited provider, we set the standard for safety, quality, and effectiveness
in occupational health. Our personalised approach ensures every solution is tailored to meet the
specific needs of your organisation, helping you create a healthier, happier, and more productive
workforce.

Whether you need ad-hoc support, one-off interventions, or long-term strategies, OH One offers the
flexibility to provide the right services at the right time. By combining quality care with value,
we help businesses of all sizes achieve their health and wellbeing goals while enhancing employee
satisfaction and productivity.

Why OH One?

At OH One, we combine clinical expertise with a personal touch. Our timely and responsive approach
ensures your health concerns are addressed swiftly, helping your employees recover faster and return
to work with renewed energy.

Our reputation for excellence is reflected in our SEQOHS accreditation, and our services are
endorsed by Dr David C Batman, a leading Occupational Health Expert and Consultant Occupational
Health Physician.

We work with UK businesses across a range of industries, from SMEs to large organisations,
delivering practical and cost-effective solutions that drive results.

To learn more about what makes OH One the trusted choice for occupational health, visit our [Why
Choose Us ][87]page.

[Get in touch][88] with us today for a free consultation to discover how we can build a healthier,
happier future for your business.

Our Bespoke Health and Wellbeing Solutions
* [Health Surveillance UK]
  
  ## HSE-Compliant Health Surveillance
  
  Health surveillance is a legal requirement for employers whose staff are exposed to health risks
  such as noise, vibration, or hazardous substances. Our service supports you in meeting your HSE
  obligations with tailored programmes that include HAVS assessments, audiometry, skin checks, and
  more. Our process is efficient, confidential, and aligned with the latest UK workplace health
  standards.
  
  [Find out more][89]
* [A woman with long blonde hair sitting at a desk, engaging in a video call on her computer with
  another woman who is speaking and gesturing with her hands.]
  
  ## Occupational Health Assessments
  
  Expert guidance to support employees experiencing health issues that affect their ability to work.
  Whether the concern is a physical, mental health condition, or neurodivergence, we assess how the
  issue impacts job performance and recommend adjustments to aid recovery and reintegration into the
  workplace.
  
  [Find out more][90]
* [Neurodiversity training at work for managers]
  
  ## Bespoke Workplace Health and Wellbeing Training
  
  Empower your workforce with OH One’s bespoke health and wellbeing training, designed for the
  evolving needs of today’s hybrid and remote workplaces. Led by occupational health professionals,
  our sessions are practical, engaging, and fully customisable for your sector.
  
  [Find out more][91]
* [man in therapy]
  
  ## Counselling & Talking Therapies (BACP Accredited)
  
  Our flexible model is designed to meet people where they are emotionally and geographically,
  ensuring accessibility for every employee.
  
  We’ve helped 6,500+ individuals and over 1,000 businesses across the UK who trust us to care for
  their teams.
  
  [Find out more][92]

Tailored Occupational Health Support - Wherever You Are, Whatever Your Industry.

We’re here to support your team’s health and wellbeing — whether you're in healthcare,
manufacturing, housing, construction, retail, education, tech, or beyond. Our occupational health
solutions are designed to fit your needs, no matter your location, sector, or workforce setup.

Call us now on [0333 772 1697][93] or

Email: [info@OH-One.co.uk][94]

Get in touch with our account managers and let us help you find the occupational health support that
actually fits your team.

flexibility to provide the right services at the right time. By combining quality care with value,
we help businesses of all sizes achieve their health and wellbeing goals while enhancing employee
satisfaction and productivity.

ensures your health concerns are addressed swiftly, helping your employees recover faster and return
to work with renewed energy.

endorsed by Dr David C Batman, a leading Occupational Health Expert and Consultant Occupational
Health Physician.

We work with UK businesses across a range of industries, from SMEs to large organisations,
delivering practical and cost-effective solutions that drive results.

happier future for your business.

# IMPROVING LIVES IN RURAL AND REMOTE COMMUNITIES

Wilderness Medical Staffing places physicians, physician assistants, nurse practitioners, and CRNAs
in exciting locum tenens opportunities throughout rural and remote communities in the Northwest and
Alaska. WMS providers deliver essential medical care to these areas, ensuring communities receive
the healthcare they deserve. Whether you’re a provider looking for a fulfilling opportunity or a
client seeking skilled medical professionals, we’re here to connect you.

[START YOUR ADVENTURE][50] [GET STARTED STAFFING][51] [VIEW OPEN JOBS][52]

## BRINGING COMPASSIONATE HEALTHCARE PROFESSIONALS TO COMMUNITIES IN NEED

At Wilderness Medical Staffing, we connect nurse practitioners, physicians, physician assistants and
CRNAs with unique and rewarding opportunities to ignite their passion for medicine. Our exciting
locum tenens placements cater to healthcare providers at every career stage. Serving healthcare
facilities and industrial employers across the Northwest and Alaska, we are the only firm dedicated
exclusively to these regions. With our extensive experience, we expertly manage all placement
details, ensuring a seamless process for both providers and clients. Watch our video to discover our
mission and how we can meet your staffing or career needs.

[FIND LOCUM OPPORTUNITIES][53] [LEARN MORE ABOUT STAFFING][54]

### Mary Ellen Doty, NP, Explains Why She Started WMS

## YOUR HEALTHCARE STAFFING AGENCY

Understanding the unique demands of staffing in rural and remote areas, we ensure the WMS providers
and the employers we work with are matched based on shared goals of providing excellent medical care
to deserving communities.
* #### RURAL AND REMOTE FOCUSED
  
  WMS healthcare providers work exclusively for employers in rural and remote areas of Alaska,
  Montana, Washington, Wyoming, Idaho, and Colorado.
* #### COMPETITIVE RATES AND PAY
  
  Providers earn the pay they deserve, while employers stay profitable by providing continuous care
  for their communities.
* #### FLEXIBLE ASSIGNMENTS
  
  By creating schedules that work best for each client, providers have flexibility of when and where
  to work.

[VIEW OPEN JOBS][55] [GET STARTED STAFFING][56]

## For Medical Providers

### A SPIRIT OF CARING, A SPIRIT OF EXPLORATION

Medicine is an adventure. That’s one of the reasons you devoted your life to caring for others. Now,
take that adventure to the next level with a locum tenens placement through Wilderness Medical
Staffing. The life you change the most may be your own.

### THE CHOICE IS
### STILL YOURS

Because locum tenens placements through Wilderness Medical Staffing are so flexible and
well-compensated, they’re perfect for healthcare careers at any stage. Choose where, when, and how
long you want your short or long-term locum tenens job to be, and we’ll get you started.

[LEARN MORE ABOUT WORKING WITH WMS][57]

## For Employers

### WE ARE RURAL LOCUM TENENS
### PLACEMENT EXPERTS

By focusing on staffing nurse practitioners, physician assistants, and physicians experienced in
rural and remote areas, WMS ensures that clients receive tailored locum tenens staffing solutions
that meet the unique challenges of your community. Our providers specialize in primary care, urgent
care, emergency medicine, pediatrics, and behavioral health.

Serving over 200 clients, we collaborate with a diverse array of facilities including critical
access hospitals, integrated health systems, private clinics, tribal health organizations, and
industry partners in need of comprehensive occupational health support thoughout the Northwestern
United States and Alaska.

# Opet Fuchs Hakkında

Otomotiv ve endüstriyel yağlayıcılar ile oto bakım ürünlerini İzmir Aliağa’da bulunan yepyeni üretim
tesisimizde üretiyor, alanında uzman çalışan kadromuz ve tüm Türkiye’de bulunan geniş bayi ağımız
ile hizmet veriyoruz.

[Bayi]

Test Cihazı

[Pie]

Test Metodu

[Oil]

Ürün Çeşidi

[User]

Uzman Çalışan

## Ürünler

[[Opet Madeni Yağlar]][212]

Otomotiv ve endüstriyel sektörlere yönelik yüksek performanslı, dayanıklı yağ çözümleri sunan, Opet
Madeni Yağları ürünlerini incelemek için [ tıklayınız!][213]

[[fuchs]][214]

Dünya çapında tanınan bir marka olan, otomotiv, endüstri ve madencilik gibi sektörlere yönelik
yenilikçi ve yüksek kaliteli yağlayıcı çözümler sunan lider madeni yağ markası Fuchs ürünleri için [
tıklayınız!][215]

[[Fmy]][216]

Opet Fuchs tarafından Ford araçlar için özel olarak geliştirilen ve test edilen yüksek performanslı
madeni yağlar ve yağlayıcılar sunan FMY markalı ürünleri incelemenin ayrıcalığını [ keşfedin!][217]

[[Rom]][218]

Opet Fuchs’un özellikle otomobil bakımı ve uzun ömrülülük için geliştirdiği yardımcı bakım ürünleri
olan madeni yağ markası ROM ürünleri için [ tıklayınız!][219]

# **Follow companies that matter to you — and make smarter business decisions**

Owler's exclusive company and industry insights make it easy to find competitors, leads, and
up-to-date news – so you can optimize your prospecting and sales results.

## For business professionals who want a serious competitive advantage

Owler Pro gives you access to premium features that keep your business in the loop about relevant
company, competitor, and industry news – so you can find qualified leads, improve your outreach, and
build better relationships with your customers.

**Follow an unlimited amount of companies relevant to your business needs**

**Discover new accounts, industry trends, and more**

**Get the latest news updates to stay ahead**

[ Learn about Owler Pro ][63]

I start my day on Owler looking for nuggets that would be worth mentioning to my target accounts.
They're always very insightful

Kodak M
Account Executive

## For people who want an easier way to follow up to 5 companies that matter to them

Join Owler’s active community of 5 million+ business professionals and get exclusive insights about
competitors, prospects, and market updates that are only available to Owler users – so you can
ensure you stay ahead of the competition.

**Find detailed company information**

**Discover your closest competitors**

**Get real-time alerts and daily emails about relevant company and market news**

[ Learn about Owler Community ][64]

## What makes Owler different?

Discover your direct and indirect competitors with Owler's exclusive competitor graph.

Search accurate private and public company data for over 20 million companies.

Create targeted lists to get daily, personalized emails and alerts about news and companies that
matter to you.

Access detailed company data, including revenue, employee count, funding history, acquisitions,
news, and more.

Filter Owler’s entire database by revenue, sector, location, employee count, and public/private
company status.

##### Precision Health

wellness programmes and strategies to improve the overall health of your employee population.

Combining medical expertise and innovative health technologies, we empower employees to better
understand and take ownership of their personal health & wellbeing.

## Amazing health starts with amazing healthcare.

When healthcare is easy, people are healthier.
When people are healthier, their organizations thrive.

## Healthcare is better with Premise.

[How we’re different][72][Our results][73][Advanced primary care][74]

## 30% savings with Premise Health.

When people are healthier, their organizations can thrive. In a claims-based analysis of 207,000
eligible lives from across 26 organizations, the results were clear: advanced primary care leads to
better health and lower healthcare costs. The study methodology was validated by Milliman, an
independently recognized actuary.

[Read success story][75]

## Great care anywhere.

Millions of members. More than 400 employer, union, and health plan partners. A national presence.
Premise is the leading direct healthcare company in the nation, with 800 wellness centers across 46
states and Guam. It offers more than 30 types of care and a proven model that improves health and
reduces healthcare costs for you and your people.

## The proof is in the outcomes.

### 30%

Average total cost of care savings

### 52%

Reduction in inpatient hospital admissions

### 20%

Increase in routine, preventive, and mental health office visits

### 17%

Reduction in emergency room visits

## Putting the “advanced” in advanced primary care.

Have you heard about advanced primary care? It combines easy access, helpful technology, and
whole-person care to improve population health. Our approach brings better healthcare to members and
real value to their organizations.

### Convenient, integrated mental health

### Comprehensive, easy-to-access primary care

### High-touch, consultative pharmacy

### Data-driven, proactive condition management

### Concierge care navigation and referrals

[See our impact][76]

## Forward thinking for those looking to get ahead.

[

### Employers

][77]

Better healthcare for your employees and their families, right where they work or live.

[Learn more][78]
[

### Consultants and Brokers

][79]

30+ types of care with onsite, nearsite, and digital capabilities to best serve members.

[Learn more][80]
[

### Health Plans

][81]

Convenient, integrated advanced primary care that fits seamlessly into your health plan offerings.

[Learn more][82]
[

### Unions and Labor

][83]

Treating your members, families, and retirees like our own.

[Learn more][84]

## More access, more value.

At Premise, we’re recreating healthcare to be everything you need it to be. We’re removing barriers
instead of putting them up so we can serve your mind, body, and spirit.

## Healthcare made for you.

Next-day appointments and short wait times. A user-friendly app and a team you know and trust. At
Premise, you’re a member – not a number. We redesigned healthcare from the ground up to make it easy
to get the care you need to be your best.  

[Learn more][85]

## Happy members make us happy.

> Staff is awesome! Compassionate and professional. From check-in to service, top notch all the way.

– Member in Arizona

> I’ve had issues with my neck and shoulder for years. I feel like I’m finally heading in the right
> direction.

– Union member in Minnesota

> The doctor listened to my concerns, was clear on treatment, and the atmosphere was warm and
> welcoming.

– Member in Texas

## Amazing health starts with amazing healthcare.

When healthcare is easy, people are healthier.
When people are healthier, their organizations thrive.

## Healthcare is better with Premise.

[How we’re different][72][Our results][73][Advanced primary care][74]

## 30% savings with Premise Health.

When people are healthier, their organizations can thrive. In a claims-based analysis of 207,000
eligible lives from across 26 organizations, the results were clear: advanced primary care leads to
better health and lower healthcare costs. The study methodology was validated by Milliman, an
independently recognized actuary.

[Read success story][75]

## Great care anywhere.

Millions of members. More than 400 employer, union, and health plan partners. A national presence.
Premise is the leading direct healthcare company in the nation, with 800 wellness centers across 46
states and Guam. It offers more than 30 types of care and a proven model that improves health and
reduces healthcare costs for you and your people.

## The proof is in the outcomes.

### 30%

Average total cost of care savings

### 52%

Reduction in inpatient hospital admissions

### 20%

Increase in routine, preventive, and mental health office visits

### 17%

Reduction in emergency room visits

## Putting the “advanced” in advanced primary care.

Have you heard about advanced primary care? It combines easy access, helpful technology, and
whole-person care to improve population health. Our approach brings better healthcare to members and
real value to their organizations.

### Convenient, integrated mental health

### Comprehensive, easy-to-access primary care

Hana ZemanováTraining & Development Manager, Zentiva Group, a.s.

Honza HanzálekHR, NAKIT

# Smart Occupational Health

ROC is a dynamic and proactive occupational health company providing exceptional private healthcare
services. Working across many industries, we are the market leaders in providing a bespoke,
productive service, ranging from multinational corporations to small local businesses. Our
Clinicians are registered with the FCDO and are very experienced in providing visa medical services.

[Contact Us][43]
[Book an appointment][44]

**What we do**

ROC works with top specialists in private medicine to deliver a comprehensive, tailored occupational
health service across a wide range of industries.

[Read More >][45]

**Locations**

We manage clients at [locations][46] throughout the world from our offices in **[Harley Street,
London][47]**, and **[Westhill, Aberdee][48][n][49]**. To date we have delivered OH consultancy
services to the UK, Norway, France, Europe, US, Brazil, Africa and the Middle East.

**Offshore Health Specialists**

Our team provide the expert support that companies operating offshore require, which allows us to
deliver a solution to all challenges. Whether it is 24/7 advice or a medical requirement, our
clinicians have extensive experience in Offshore Medicine and Remote Healthcare.

[Read More >][50]

**We work with some amazing clients:**

[Orsted][Orsted] [Diamond Offshore 1][Diamond Offshore 1] [Assala Energy 1][Assala Energy 1] [Africa
Oil Corp][Africa Oil Corp]

## **Our Occupational Health** **Services**

We cover a comprehensive range of services to support your company’s health requirements.

### **Offshore Medicals**

Offshore workers must undertake a medical examination that classifies them as medically fit to work
before travelling offshore. Our doctors are approved to conduct Oil & Gas UK (OGUK) Medicals as well
as Wind and Turbine Medicals.

[Read More >][51]

### **Case Management**

Case Management improves outcomes in sickness absence, rehabilitation, work related illness/injury,
and ill-health retirement. ROC Health helps workers back to full capacity so they can make a safe
return to work.

[Read More >][52]

### **Health Surveillance**

Promoting the systematic, early identification of work-related ill-health to aid treatment and
prevent further damage, health surveillance can be necessary to meet statutory, non-statutory or UK
legal requirements.

[Read More >][53]

### **Cruise Ship Medicals (PEME & REME)**

At our CQC-regulated clinic in London and HIS-regulated clinic in Aberdeen, we deliver fully
compliant cruise ship medicals with fast turnaround times, on-site diagnostics, and expert knowledge
of cruise line requirements.

[Read More >][54]

### **D4 Driver Medicals – HGV, LGV, PCV & C1 Medicals**

We provide DVLA D4 driver medicals for HGV, LGV, PCV and C1 drivers across Aberdeen and London,
ensuring you remain compliant with Driver and Vehicle Licensing Agency (DVLA) Group 2 medical
standards.

[Read More >][55]

### ******Travel Health******

We provide pre-travel medicals, vaccinations, malaria prevention, and country-specific health advice
at our clinics in London and Aberdeen to help employees stay healthy while working abroad. All our
clinics are Yellow Fever registered centres.

[Read More >][56]

[See our full range of services >][57]

At Routemedic, we specialize in delivering end-to-end healthcare execution solutions tailored for
workplaces, communities, and institutions across India. From organizing pre-employment and annual
health checkups, to setting up Occupational Health Centres (OHCs), deploying certified medical
staff, and conducting First Aid & CPR training — we ensure quality care is accessible,
efficient, and compliant. 

Through strategic partnerships with leading healthcare providers like Apollo Clinics, Zenzo, RED
Health, and Sanjeevni Mamta Hospital, we bridge the gap between healthcare needs and seamless
service delivery, right at your doorstep. 

Whether you’re a corporate entity, a school, a factory, or a housing society, Routemedic is your
trusted partner for building a healthier environment, one service at a time.

We enable efficient delivery of healthcare services **on-site** through strategic partnerships and
medical workforce deployment. Our services are ideal for workplaces, industries, events, and remote
communities.

## hello & welcome.

We are the Smart Clinic, a specialist, SEQOHS-accredited provider of occupational health and
corporate wellbeing packages to organisations around the UK.

Our service ensures that you and your colleagues have access to market leading support, quickly,
conveniently and affordably. For the price of a cup of coffee, your team can join our wellbeing
revolution.

Go ahead, [**find out more**][90].

contracts.

Whether you’re a business, school or charity, we’ll help you to manage your staff absences with fast
and efficient oh support.

[Learn More][92]

We’re proud to do things a little differently. To see how our awesome support services and wellbeing
‘app’ work, take the video tour.

### Enhance employee wellbeing

Discover Spire Workplace Health’s comprehensive occupational health services designed to boost
employee wellbeing and productivity. From proactive absence management to health surveillance and
mental health support, we tailor solutions to your organisation’s needs.

[Learn more][50]

 

### Ready to partner with us?

Are you ready to embark on a journey to occupational health excellence? [Contact our team][51] today
to discuss your organisation’s needs and explore how we can support your quest for a healthier,
happier workforce.

## Frequently asked questions

#### Does OH support employer/employee or both?

Both! There is often a misconception that occupational health only benefits an employer. This isn’t
the case. Occupational health is mutually beneficial for both an employer and employees.

As an employer, occupational health helps you make decisions with respect to health and safety in
the workplace, where it specifically relates to employees. The information and advice given to
employers is in practical, not medical terms, with the aim of making the working environment a
compliant, safe place for employees and flagging any adjustments that may need to be made.

As an employee, occupational health benefits you as you have the right to be able to complete your
job in a safe, healthy environment that prioritises your wellbeing.

#### Do I need to sign into an agreement/What support packages do you have on offer?

For any occupational health work to be carried out, we require a contractual agreement in place. Our
desire is to become your independent occupational health provider and support you on an ongoing
basis, rather than a one-off.

We work closely with prospective clients to understand their needs to provide them with the best
solution for their organisation – this could be a contract with monthly billing to cover any
occupational work undertaken, or we can offer an inclusion-based package. If you’re unsure what is
right for you, contact our team for a no-obligation consultation.

#### Do you do one off referrals?

We currently do not offer one-off referrals due to our desire to work as an ongoing partner provider
with our clients. We are however working on a pay as you go solution for smaller clients, so watch
this space.

#### How long will the implementation of my account take before I can access services?

We pride ourselves on an efficient turnaround and hassle-free onboarding.

Depending on the size of your business and the level of support required, we can in some cases, get
you up and running within ten working days from contract signing. Please note, that this is
dependent on varying factors, so your specific timelines will be discussed during consultation.

#### Will I have dedicated personnel assigned to our organisation?

As a client, you will have access to the relevant people in our team required to deliver your
occupational health services. However, access to dedicated personnel will depend on the scale of
requirements in your organisation. If required, we can assign you with the following:
* Dedicated clinical lead
* Dedicated account manager
* Dedicated corporate servicing manager

#### What portal do you use? Can I track activity within the portal?

We use eOPAS currently. All activity, including the progress of cases from start to finish, can be
tracked within the portal.

Access to the portal will be given to appropriate team members based on a portal hierarchy you
advise us (our portal team will support the build of this).

#### What added value do you offer?

As a retained client, you will have access to a full suite of additional benefits including:
* telephone support and advice
* assistance in the development of company policies
* dedicated booking pages for employees
* e-newsletters
* an annual health calendar
* marketing support

#### Do you provide M.I reports and if so at what frequency?

Yes, we do! The frequency of MI reports will be dependent on the requirement (scale) but can be
provided at an agreed frequency e.g. monthly, quarterly, annually etc.

A management information report is a statistical and trend-based report (using anonymised data) that
outlines your service usage e.g. how many people have been referred.

## Frequently asked questions

#### Does OH support employer/employee or both?

Both! There is often a misconception that occupational health only benefits an employer. This isn’t
the case. Occupational health is mutually beneficial for both an employer and employees.

As an employer, occupational health helps you make decisions with respect to health and safety in
the workplace, where it specifically relates to employees. The information and advice given to
employers is in practical, not medical terms, with the aim of making the working environment a
compliant, safe place for employees and flagging any adjustments that may need to be made.

As an employee, occupational health benefits you as you have the right to be able to complete your
job in a safe, healthy environment that prioritises your wellbeing.

#### Do I need to sign into an agreement/What support packages do you have on offer?

For any occupational health work to be carried out, we require a contractual agreement in place. Our
desire is to become your independent occupational health provider and support you on an ongoing
basis, rather than a one-off.

We work closely with prospective clients to understand their needs to provide them with the best
solution for their organisation – this could be a contract with monthly billing to cover any
occupational work undertaken, or we can offer an inclusion-based package. If you’re unsure what is
right for you, contact our team for a no-obligation consultation.

#### Do you do one off referrals?

We currently do not offer one-off referrals due to our desire to work as an ongoing partner provider
with our clients. We are however working on a pay as you go solution for smaller clients, so watch
this space.

#### How long will the implementation of my account take before I can access services?

We pride ourselves on an efficient turnaround and hassle-free onboarding.

Depending on the size of your business and the level of support required, we can in some cases, get
you up and running within ten working days from contract signing. Please note, that this is
dependent on varying factors, so your specific timelines will be discussed during consultation.

#### Will I have dedicated personnel assigned to our organisation?

As a client, you will have access to the relevant people in our team required to deliver your
occupational health services. However, access to dedicated personnel will depend on the scale of
requirements in your organisation. If required, we can assign you with the following:
* Dedicated clinical lead
* Dedicated account manager
* Dedicated corporate servicing manager

#### What portal do you use? Can I track activity within the portal?

We use eOPAS currently. All activity, including the progress of cases from start to finish, can be
tracked within the portal.

Access to the portal will be given to appropriate team members based on a portal hierarchy you
advise us (our portal team will support the build of this).

#### What added value do you offer?

As a retained client, you will have access to a full suite of additional benefits including:
* telephone support and advice
* assistance in the development of company policies
* dedicated booking pages for employees
* e-newsletters
* an annual health calendar
* marketing support

#### Do you provide M.I reports and if so at what frequency?

Yes, we do! The frequency of MI reports will be dependent on the requirement (scale) but can be
provided at an agreed frequency e.g. monthly, quarterly, annually etc.

A management information report is a statistical and trend-based report (using anonymised data) that
outlines your service usage e.g. how many people have been referred.

## Full-Service Occupational Health for Employers

From pre-employment physicals and DOT compliance to OSHA medical surveillance and return to duty
evaluations — everything managed in one employer portal, available nationwide.

### Pre-Employment Physical

Fitness-for-duty evaluations for new hires in any industry — construction, healthcare,
manufacturing, transportation, and staffing. Confirm employees can safely perform their job before
day one.

All industries · Non-DOT

### DOT Physical Exam

FMCSA-certified medical examinations for CDL drivers. Covers all DOT agencies — FMCSA, FAA, FRA,
FTA, PHMSA, USCG. Medical Examiner Certificate issued same day at 15,000+ sites nationwide.

$110 · FMCSA certified

### Workplace Drug & Alcohol Testing

DOT-compliant and non-DOT urine, oral fluid, and hair follicle drug screens. Evidential breath
alcohol testing (EBT). Pre-employment, random, post-accident, reasonable suspicion, and return to
duty.

5, 10 & expanded panels

### Random Drug Testing Program (C-TPA)

FMCSA-compliant consortium enrollment and random pool management for employers of all sizes.
Quarterly draws, MRO review, Clearinghouse reporting, annual MIS reports, and audit-ready
recordkeeping.

From $49/yr per driver

### Return to Duty Physical

DOT return to duty testing after a drug or alcohol violation — negative test required before
resuming safety-sensitive duties. Non-DOT fitness-for-duty clearance after injury or illness. [Learn
more →][47]

DOT & non-DOT

### Respirator Fit Testing

OSHA-compliant qualitative (QLFT) and quantitative (QNFT) respirator fit testing. Required for
workers using tight-fitting respirators under OSHA 29 CFR 1910.134.

OSHA 29 CFR 1910.134

### OSHA Medical Questionnaire

Physician-reviewed OSHA respiratory medical evaluation questionnaire (Appendix C). Required before
any employee uses a tight-fitting respirator in the workplace.

Physician reviewed

### Audiogram Testing

OSHA-compliant baseline and annual audiometric testing for workers exposed to occupational noise.
Required under OSHA's Hearing Conservation Standard (29 CFR 1910.95).

OSHA 29 CFR 1910.95

### Pulmonary Function Test (PFT)

Spirometry for workers exposed to respiratory hazards — silica, asbestos, chemical fumes. Required
for OSHA medical surveillance programs in construction, mining, and manufacturing.

Spirometry · OSHA compliant

### FMCSA Clearinghouse

Pre-employment and annual Clearinghouse queries, violation reporting, and driver consent management.
Required for all DOT-regulated employers with CDL drivers.

FMCSA required

### Vision & Color Testing

Snellen visual acuity and Ishihara color plate testing for pre-employment and annual occupational
health screenings. Required for many safety-sensitive and transportation roles.

Pre-employment · Annual

### Vaccinations & Titer Testing

Occupational vaccination programs — flu, Hep A & B, Tdap, MMR, varicella. Titer testing for immunity
verification for healthcare workers, school employees, and new hires.

Healthcare · Schools · Construction

alcohol testing (EBT). Pre-employment, random, post-accident, reasonable suspicion, and return to
duty.

5, 10 & expanded panels

### Random Drug Testing Program (C-TPA)

FMCSA-compliant consortium enrollment and random pool management for employers of all sizes.
Quarterly draws, MRO review, Clearinghouse reporting, annual MIS reports, and audit-ready
recordkeeping.

From $49/yr per driver

### Return to Duty Physical

DOT return to duty testing after a drug or alcohol violation — negative test required before
resuming safety-sensitive duties. Non-DOT fitness-for-duty clearance after injury or illness. [Learn
more →][47]

DOT & non-DOT

### Respirator Fit Testing

OSHA-compliant qualitative (QLFT) and quantitative (QNFT) respirator fit testing. Required for
workers using tight-fitting respirators under OSHA 29 CFR 1910.134.

OSHA 29 CFR 1910.134

### OSHA Medical Questionnaire

Physician-reviewed OSHA respiratory medical evaluation questionnaire (Appendix C). Required before
any employee uses a tight-fitting respirator in the workplace.

Physician reviewed

### Audiogram Testing

OSHA-compliant baseline and annual audiometric testing for workers exposed to occupational noise.
Required under OSHA's Hearing Conservation Standard (29 CFR 1910.95).

OSHA 29 CFR 1910.95

### Pulmonary Function Test (PFT)

Spirometry for workers exposed to respiratory hazards — silica, asbestos, chemical fumes. Required
for OSHA medical surveillance programs in construction, mining, and manufacturing.

Spirometry · OSHA compliant

### FMCSA Clearinghouse

Pre-employment and annual Clearinghouse queries, violation reporting, and driver consent management.
Required for all DOT-regulated employers with CDL drivers.

FMCSA required

### Vision & Color Testing

Snellen visual acuity and Ishihara color plate testing for pre-employment and annual occupational
health screenings. Required for many safety-sensitive and transportation roles.

Pre-employment · Annual

### Vaccinations & Titer Testing

Occupational vaccination programs — flu, Hep A & B, Tdap, MMR, varicella. Titer testing for immunity
verification for healthcare workers, school employees, and new hires.

Healthcare · Schools · Construction

# Whatishumanresource.com

Human Resource refer to the individuals or personnel or workforce within an organisation responsible
for performing the tasks given to them for the purpose of achievement of goals and objectives of the
organisation which is possible only through proper recruitment and selection, providing proper
orientation an induction, training, skill developments, proper assessment of employees (performance
appraisal), providing appropriate compensation and benefits, maintaining proper labour relations and
ultimately maintaining safety, welfare and health concern of employees, which is process of the
human resource management.

(26 December 1880 - 7 September 1949)

# Whatishumanresource.com

Human Resource refer to the individuals or personnel or workforce within an organisation responsible
for performing the tasks given to them for the purpose of achievement of goals and objectives of the
organisation which is possible only through proper recruitment and selection, providing proper
orientation an induction, training, skill developments, proper assessment of employees (performance
appraisal), providing appropriate compensation and benefits, maintaining proper labour relations and
ultimately maintaining safety, welfare and health concern of employees, which is process of the
human resource management.

Father of Human Resource Management  [George Elton Mayo][30] >>

(26 December 1880 - 7 September 1949)
